title.zh: 卷313 列傳一百 兆惠 阿里衮 豐升额 布彦达赉 舒赫德 舒常
title.en: Volume 313 Biographies 100: Zhao Hui, A Li Gun, Feng Shenge, Bu Yan Da Lai, Shu Hede, Shu Chang
title.raw: 卷313 列傳一百 兆惠 阿里衮 豐升额 布彦达赉 舒赫德 舒常

sentences.zh: 列傳一百

translations.literal: Biographies 100
translations.idiomatic: Biographies 100

sentences.zh: 兆惠阿里袞子豐升額布彥達賚舒赫德子舒常

translations.literal: Zhaohui; Ali Gun; [Ali Gun's] son Feng Shenge; Bu Yandabai; Shuhede; [Shuhede's] son Shuchang
translations.idiomatic: Zhaohui; Ali Gun; Feng Shenge, son of Ali Gun; Bu Yandabai; Shuhede; Shuchang, son of Shuhede

sentences.zh: 兆惠，字和甫，吳雅氏，滿洲正黃旗人，孝恭仁皇后族孫。

translations.literal: Zhaohui, style name He Fu, of the Wuya clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner and a clansman of Empress Dowager Xiaogongren.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaohui, whose style was He Fu, belonged to the Wuya clan. A Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner, he was a kinsman of Empress Dowager Xiaogongren.

sentences.zh: 父佛標，官至都統。

translations.literal: His father Fubiao rose to the rank of commandant.
translations.idiomatic: His father Fubiao served as commandant.

sentences.zh: 兆惠，以筆帖式直軍機處。

translations.literal: Zhaohui entered service as a bitishi attached to the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaohui began as a bitishi on duty at the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 七遷至刑部侍郎、正黃旗滿洲副都統、鑲紅旗護軍統領。

translations.literal: Through seven promotions he reached vice minister of Justice, Manchu deputy lieutenant-general of the Plain Yellow Banner, and commandant of the Bordered Red Banner guards.
translations.idiomatic: In seven steps he rose to vice minister of Justice, Manchu deputy lieutenant-general of the Plain Yellow Banner, and commandant of the Bordered Red Banner guards.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十三年，命兼領戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Qianlong he was ordered concurrently to hold the vice ministership of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 13 he was also appointed vice minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 赴金川督糧運，疏論糧運事，並言諸將惟烏爾登，哈攀龍勇往，並及諸行省遣兵多不實。

translations.literal: He went to Jinchuan to supervise grain transport, memorialized on transport affairs, and stated that among the generals only Ulden and Hapanlong advanced boldly; he also reported that many provinces' troop levies were inflated.
translations.idiomatic: Sent to Jinchuan to oversee grain transport, he submitted a memorial on supply lines and said that of the field commanders only Ulden and Hapanlong fought with real daring, while many provincial troop figures were false.

sentences.zh: 上命告經略傅恆覈實。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered that Fu Heng, the campaign commander, verify the facts.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor told campaign commander Fu Heng to investigate.

sentences.zh: 師還，命覈軍需。

translations.literal: When the army returned, he was ordered to audit military supplies.
translations.idiomatic: After the army came home, he was told to audit military supplies.

sentences.zh: 調戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was transferred to vice minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He was moved to vice minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 赴山東按傳鈔尚書孫嘉淦偽疏稿，暫署巡撫。

translations.literal: He went to Shandong to investigate the circulated forged memorial ascribed to Minister Sun Jia'gan and temporarily acted as governor.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent to Shandong to investigate the forged memorial circulated in Sun Jia'gan's name and served briefly as acting governor.

sentences.zh: 十八年，命赴西藏防準噶爾。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he was ordered to Tibet to guard against the Dzungars.
translations.idiomatic: In year 18 he was ordered to Tibet to guard against Dzungar threats.

sentences.zh: 十九年，議用兵，命協理北路軍務，並督糧運。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, when war was debated, he was ordered to assist in northern-route military affairs and to supervise grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: In year 19, as war was being planned, he was assigned to help manage the northern front and oversee grain transport.

sentences.zh: 二十年，命駐烏里雅蘇台。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he was ordered to garrison Uliassutai.
translations.idiomatic: In year 20 he was posted to Uliassutai.

sentences.zh: 準噶爾台吉噶勒藏多爾濟降，命兆惠畀以牲畜。

translations.literal: When the Dzungar taiji Galdan Dorji submitted, the Emperor ordered Zhaohui to give him livestock.
translations.idiomatic: When Dzungar taiji Galdan Dorji surrendered, the Emperor had Zhaohui supply him with livestock.

sentences.zh: 是歲阿睦爾撒納叛，陷伊犁。

translations.literal: That year Amursana rebelled and seized Ili.
translations.idiomatic: That same year Amursana rebelled and took Ili.

sentences.zh: 命兆惠移駐巴里坤，兼督額林哈畢爾噶台站。

translations.literal: Zhaohui was ordered to move his garrison to Barkul and also to supervise the courier stations of Ereen Habiirga.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaohui was shifted to Barkul and put in charge of the Ereen Habiirga relay stations as well.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，師收復伊犁。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year the army recovered Ili.
translations.idiomatic: In year 21 the army recaptured Ili.

sentences.zh: 上以定西將軍策楞不勝任，召兆惠還京授方略，未行，命逮策楞，並解扎拉豐阿定邊右副將軍以授兆惠。

translations.literal: The Emperor considered Dingxi general Celeng unfit for command, recalled Zhaohui to the capital to receive strategy, and before he set out ordered Celeng arrested and relieved Zhalafeng'a of the western deputy generalship to give it to Zhaohui.
translations.idiomatic: Finding Dingxi general Celeng unequal to the task, the Emperor recalled Zhaohui to Beijing for instructions; before he marched, Celeng was arrested and Zhalafeng'a was stripped of the western deputy generalship, which was given to Zhaohui.

sentences.zh: 時阿睦爾撒納北遁哈薩克，定西將軍達爾黨阿逐捕未得，上命還師。

translations.literal: At that time Amursana had fled north into Kazakh territory; Dingxi general Dardang'a pursued but could not catch him, and the Emperor ordered the army to return.
translations.idiomatic: Amursana had fled north into Kazakh lands; Dingxi general Dardang'a chased him without success, and the Emperor ordered the troops back.

sentences.zh: 厄魯特諸宰桑從軍者謀為亂，綽囉斯汗噶勒藏多爾濟告兆惠，巴雅爾入掠其牧地。

translations.literal: Eleuth zaisang who had followed the army plotted rebellion; Choros khan Galdan Dorji informed Zhaohui that Bayar had raided his pastures.
translations.idiomatic: Eleuth zaisang in the army plotted mutiny; Choros khan Galdan Dorji told Zhaohui that Bayar had raided his pastures.

sentences.zh: 兆惠令寧夏將軍和起將百人徵厄魯特兵往禦，而噶勒藏多爾濟從子扎那噶爾布及宰桑呢嗎、哈薩克錫喇、達什策零等陰通巴雅爾，中途變作，和起死之。

translations.literal: Zhaohui ordered Ningxia general Heqi to take a hundred men and levy Eleuth troops to resist, but Galdan Dorji's nephew Zanagarbu and the zaisang Nima, Kazakh Sira, Dashiceling, and others secretly colluded with Bayar, mutinied on the march, and Heqi was killed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaohui told Ningxia general Heqi to lead a hundred men and draft Eleuth soldiers to meet the threat, yet Galdan Dorji's nephew Zanagarbu and the zaisang Nima, Kazakh Sira, Dashiceling, and others secretly sided with Bayar, turned on the column en route, and Heqi died in the fighting.

sentences.zh: 兆惠自伊犁將五百人逐捕，經濟爾哈朗至鄂壘扎拉圖，與達什策零戰，大敗之。

translations.literal: Zhaohui himself led five hundred men from Ili in pursuit, passed Jierhalang to Ele Zalatu, fought Dashiceling, and routed him.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaohui marched from Ili with five hundred men in pursuit, went by Jierhalang to Ele Zalatu, met Dashiceling in battle, and defeated him decisively.

sentences.zh: 逐賊戰於庫圖齊，再戰於達勒奇，殺賊數千。

translations.literal: Pursuing the rebels he fought at Kutuchi and again at Daleqi, killing several thousand bandits.
translations.idiomatic: In pursuit he fought at Kutuchi and again at Daleqi, slaying several thousand rebels.

sentences.zh: 二十二年正月，至烏魯木齊。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twenty-second year he reached Urumqi.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 22 he reached Urumqi.

sentences.zh: 噶勒藏多爾濟、扎那噶爾布等諸賊皆會，日數十戰，馬且盡。

translations.literal: Galdan Dorji, Zanagarbu, and the other rebels gathered; there were dozens of battles a day, and the horses were nearly exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: Galdan Dorji, Zanagarbu, and the other rebel leaders massed; they fought dozens of skirmishes a day until their horses were almost spent.

sentences.zh: 師步行冰雪中，至特訥格爾，遂被圍。

translations.literal: The army marched on foot through ice and snow to Teneger and was then surrounded.
translations.idiomatic: The troops trudged through ice and snow to Teneger and there were encircled.

sentences.zh: 巴里坤辦事大臣雅爾哈善先遣侍衛圖倫楚將兵八百益兆惠軍。

translations.literal: Yarhashan, the Barkul commissioner, had already sent bodyguard Tulenchu with eight hundred men to reinforce Zhaohui's force.
translations.idiomatic: Barkul commissioner Yarhashan had already dispatched bodyguard Tulenchu with eight hundred men to strengthen Zhaohui.

sentences.zh: 會兆惠遣軍校雲多克德楞徹自圍中出，詣雅爾哈善言轉戰狀，事聞，上嘉兆惠奮勇，封一等武毅伯，授戶部尚書、鑲白旗漢軍都統、領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: When Zhaohui sent the officer Yundokdelengche out of the siege to report the fighting to Yarhashan, the matter reached the throne; the Emperor praised Zhaohui's valor, enfeoffed him as a first-class Martial Resolution baron, and appointed him minister of Revenue, lieutenant-general of the Bordered White Banner Chinese, and grand minister of the inner guard.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaohui sent officer Yundokdelengche out of the encirclement to tell Yarhashan how the battles had gone; when word reached court the Emperor commended his courage, made him a first-class Martial Resolution baron, and gave him the ministries of Revenue, the Bordered White Chinese banner command, and the inner guard grand ministership.

sentences.zh: 及圖倫楚兵至，圍解，兆惠得新兵，复逐捕巴雅爾至穆壘河源。

translations.literal: When Tulenchu's troops arrived the siege was lifted; Zhaohui with fresh soldiers again pursued Bayar to the headwaters of the Mulei River.
translations.idiomatic: Once Tulenchu's men came the ring was broken; reinforced, Zhaohui chased Bayar again to the upper Mulei.

sentences.zh: 巴雅爾已徙牧他處，乃還師巴里坤。

translations.literal: Bayar had already moved his herds elsewhere, so the army returned to Barkul.
translations.idiomatic: Bayar had shifted his herds, so the column withdrew to Barkul.

sentences.zh: 上以兆惠遠道旋師，逐賊不怠，賚御用玉韘、荷包、鼻煙壺，命同定邊將軍成袞扎布分路剪除厄魯特。

translations.literal: Because Zhaohui had marched far and turned back yet never slackened the pursuit, the Emperor rewarded him with an imperial jade thumb-ring, purse, and snuff bottle, and ordered him and Pacification of the Frontier general Chengun Zhabu to exterminate the Eleuth by separate routes.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor, noting that Zhaohui had come a great distance, turned back, and still pressed the chase, gave him an imperial jade archer's ring, purse, and snuff bottle, and told him and Pacification general Chengun Zhabu to cut down the Eleuth on divided lines.

sentences.zh: 兆惠旋偕參贊大臣鄂實等自額林哈畢爾噶進剿。

translations.literal: Zhaohui then advanced with campaign commissioner Eshi and others from Ereen Habiirga.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaohui soon marched with commissioner Eshi and others from Ereen Habiirga.

sentences.zh: 時扎那噶爾布已殺噶勒藏多爾濟。

translations.literal: By then Zanagarbu had already killed Galdan Dorji.
translations.idiomatic: By then Zanagarbu had murdered Galdan Dorji.

sentences.zh: 會阿睦爾撒納自哈薩克盜馬竄還伊犁，掠扎那噶爾布牧地。

translations.literal: Meanwhile Amursana stole horses from the Kazakhs and slipped back to Ili, raiding Zanagarbu's pastures.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile Amursana stole horses among the Kazakhs, crept back to Ili, and plundered Zanagarbu's grazing grounds.

sentences.zh: 兆惠察回部頭人布拉呢敦、霍集占叛有跡，令參贊大臣富德逐捕阿睦爾撒納，而駐師濟爾哈朗以待。

translations.literal: Zhaohui saw signs that the Muslim chiefs Burhanuddin and Khoja Jihan were turning rebel; he ordered commissioner Fude to pursue Amursana while he held the army at Jierhalang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaohui detected signs of revolt in the Muslim chiefs Burhanuddin and Khoja Jihan; he sent commissioner Fude after Amursana and kept his own force at Jierhalang.

sentences.zh: 上責兆惠與成袞扎布急回部、緩阿睦爾撒納，失輕重。

translations.literal: The Emperor rebuked Zhaohui and Chengun Zhabu for pressing the Muslim west while treating Amursana lightly, saying they had misjudged priorities.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor scolded Zhaohui and Chengun Zhabu for hurrying into the Muslim west while going easy on Amursana—he said they had mistaken what mattered most.

sentences.zh: 兆惠乃率師繼富德以北，遣使宣諭左右哈薩克，師復進次額密勒西岸。

translations.literal: Zhaohui then led the army north after Fude, sent envoys to instruct the Kazakhs on either side, and advanced again to camp on the west bank of Emil.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaohui marched north behind Fude, sent envoys to admonish the Kazakhs on both flanks, and moved on to camp west of the Emil.

sentences.zh: 富德師至塔爾巴哈台，獲逃渠巴雅爾及其孥，檻送京師，語詳富德傳。

translations.literal: When Fude's column reached Tarbagatai it captured the fugitive ringleader Bayar and his family and sent them to Beijing in a caged cart—the details are in Fude's biography.
translations.idiomatic: Fude reached Tarbagatai, seized the fugitive Bayar and his kin, and sent them to the capital in a cage cart, as told in Fude's biography.

sentences.zh: 哈薩克汗阿布賚使獻馬，並具表請入覲，上降敕宣諭。

translations.literal: Kazakh khan Abulai's envoy presented horses and a memorial asking to come to court; the Emperor issued an edict of instruction.
translations.idiomatic: Kazakh khan Abulai's envoy brought horses and a memorial requesting an audience; the Emperor answered with a comforting edict.

sentences.zh: 阿布賚使言阿睦爾撒納以二十騎來投，約詰朝相見，令先收其馬並及牛羊。

translations.literal: The envoy said Amursana had come to submit with twenty horsemen and would meet at dawn; he was told to seize his horses, cattle, and sheep first.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy reported that Amursana was coming in with twenty riders and would meet at daybreak; he was ordered to take the horses and livestock first.

sentences.zh: 阿睦爾撒納驚走，獲其從子達什車凌、宰桑齊巴罕，縛送兆惠，兆惠以聞，命檻車致京師。

translations.literal: Amursana fled in alarm; his nephew Dashicholing and zaisang Qibahan were captured, bound, and sent to Zhaohui, who reported up; they were ordered sent to the capital in a cage cart.
translations.idiomatic: Amursana bolted in fright; his nephew Dashicholing and zaisang Qibahan were taken, bound, and sent to Zhaohui, who memorialized; the court ordered them brought to Beijing in a cage cart.

sentences.zh: 兆惠分遣諸將圖倫楚、三達保、愛隆阿擊敗阿睦爾撒納屬眾，降其渠納木奇父子，送京師。

translations.literal: Zhaohui detached generals Tulenchu, Sandabao, and Ailong'a to defeat Amursana's followers, accepted the surrender of the chief Namuqi and his son, and sent them to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaohui sent Tulenchu, Sandabao, and Ailong'a to smash Amursana's bands, received the surrender of chief Namuqi and his son, and forwarded them to court.

sentences.zh: 兆惠復進，與富德軍合，诇阿睦爾撒納已入俄羅斯。

translations.literal: Zhaohui advanced again, joined Fude's army, and learned that Amursana had entered Russia.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaohui pushed on, united with Fude, and found that Amursana had taken refuge in Russia.

sentences.zh: 上命還師。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered the army to return.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered withdrawal.

sentences.zh: 旋授兆惠定邊將軍，討布拉呢敦、霍集占。

translations.literal: Zhaohui was soon made Pacification of the Frontier general to attack Burhanuddin and Khoja Jihan.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed Pacification of the Frontier general to subdue Burhanuddin and Khoja Jihan.

sentences.zh: 兆惠奏請屯田烏魯木齊，以來春進討，倘不能即入回部，則且積穀市馬為持重，上責其怯懦。

translations.literal: Zhaohui memorialized to open garrison farms at Urumqi and strike in the coming spring; if he could not enter the Muslim west at once he would stock grain and buy horses and hold his ground—the Emperor called this cowardice.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaohui asked to farm at Urumqi and attack next spring, or if he could not enter the Muslim west yet, to hoard grain and horses and wait—the Emperor called him timid.

sentences.zh: 二十三年正月，兆惠以厄魯特人在沙喇伯勒尚萬戶，當先剿除，乃專力回部。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twenty-third year Zhaohui, seeing tens of thousands of Eleuth still at Shalabole, said they must be wiped out first and then turned his full strength to the Muslim west.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 23, with tens of thousands of Eleuth still at Shalabole, Zhaohui insisted they be destroyed first before he threw his whole force into the Muslim west.

sentences.zh: 上授雅爾哈善靖逆將軍，趣進師；

translations.literal: The Emperor made Yarhashan Pacification of Rebellion general and urged the army forward;
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor named Yarhashan Pacification of Rebellion general and pressed for a quick advance;

sentences.zh: 命兆惠剿厄魯特事竟，別道合攻。

translations.literal: he ordered that when Zhaohui had finished the Eleuth campaign he should join the attack by another route.
translations.idiomatic: he told Zhaohui to finish the Eleuth first, then link up on a separate route.

sentences.zh: 並諭兆惠：「厄魯特性反覆，往往自殘殺。

translations.literal: He also instructed Zhaohui: "The Eleuth are fickle by nature and often slaughter one another.
translations.idiomatic: He also told Zhaohui: "The Eleuth are treacherous by nature and often kill one another.

sentences.zh: 毋以其烏合稍眾，過疑慮。」

translations.literal: Do not, because they have banded together in somewhat greater numbers, let excessive doubt hold you back."
translations.idiomatic: Do not let their somewhat larger rabble make you over-cautious."

sentences.zh: 兆惠與副將軍車布登扎布等分四道進剿：兆惠趨博羅布爾噶蘇，車布登扎布趨博羅塔拉，副都統瑚爾起等趨尼勒喀，侍衛達禮善等趨齊格特，皆會於伊犁。

translations.literal: Zhaohui with deputy general Chebuden Zhabu and others advanced on four routes: Zhaohui toward Bolobulgasu, Chebuden Zhabu toward Borotala, vice lieutenant-general Hu'erqi toward Nileka, and bodyguard Dalishan toward Qigete—all meeting at Ili.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaohui and deputy Chebuden Zhabu split into four columns: Zhaohui toward Bolobulgasu, Chebuden Zhabu toward Borotala, Hu'erqi toward Nileka, Dalishan toward Qigete—all converging on Ili.

sentences.zh: 厄魯特眾紛紜潰竄，遂盡殲焉。

translations.literal: The Eleuth scattered in flight and were annihilated to the last man.
translations.idiomatic: The Eleuth broke and fled in confusion and were wiped out entirely.

sentences.zh: 上以賊渠哈薩克錫喇、鄂哲特等十餘人皆未獲，命兆惠等加意奮勉。

translations.literal: Because the rebel chiefs Kazakh Sira, Ejet, and more than ten others were still at large, the Emperor ordered Zhaohui and the rest to strive all the harder.
translations.idiomatic: With rebel leaders Kazakh Sira, Ejet, and a dozen others still free, the Emperor urged Zhaohui on.

sentences.zh: 四月，兆惠獲鄂哲特送京師，疏言：「準噶爾事將蕆，請自伊犁移師合攻回部。」

translations.literal: In the fourth month Zhaohui captured Ejet and sent him to the capital, memorializing: "The Dzungar affair is nearly settled; I ask to move the army from Ili to join the attack on the Muslim west."
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month he seized Ejet and sent him to court, writing: "The Dzungar business is nearly done; please let me shift from Ili to strike the Muslim west."

sentences.zh: 上仍責兆惠俘哈薩克錫喇等。

translations.literal: The Emperor still reproached Zhaohui for not capturing Kazakh Sira and the others.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor still faulted him for not taking Kazakh Sira and the rest.

sentences.zh: 既又令赴庫車察軍事，還京師，詔未至而兆惠師已發，會雅爾哈善圍庫車，霍集占突圍走。

translations.literal: He then also ordered him to inspect affairs at Kucha and return to the capital, but before the edict arrived Zhaohui's army had already marched; Yarhashan was besieging Kucha when Khoja Jihan broke out and fled.
translations.idiomatic: He next ordered Zhaohui to look into Kucha and come home, yet the edict had not arrived when the army was already on the road; Yarhashan was investing Kucha when Khoja Jihan broke out and escaped.

sentences.zh: 上逮雅爾哈善，以兆惠代將。

translations.literal: The Emperor arrested Yarhashan and put Zhaohui in command.
translations.idiomatic: Yarhashan was arrested and Zhaohui took command.

sentences.zh: 兆惠中途疏言：「將八百人赴庫車，當與雅爾哈善協力勦賊，不原靦顏遽還。」

translations.literal: On the march Zhaohui memorialized: "I am taking eight hundred men to Kucha and will work with Yarhashan to destroy the rebels; I am not willing to turn back in shame."
translations.idiomatic: En route Zhaohui wrote: "With eight hundred men I am going to Kucha to fight beside Yarhashan; I will not slink home in disgrace."

sentences.zh: 上獎其肫誠勇往，賜雙眼孔雀翎。

translations.literal: The Emperor praised his sincere daring and gave him a double-eyed peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor praised his earnest courage and granted a double-eyed peacock plume.

sentences.zh: 既至軍，诇霍集占自庫車出入葉爾羌城守，乃帥師往捕。

translations.literal: When he reached the army he learned Khoja Jihan had left Kucha and was holding Yarkand, and he led the troops to seize him.
translations.idiomatic: At the front he learned Khoja Jihan had quit Kucha to defend Yarkand and marched to take him.

sentences.zh: 道阿克蘇，頭人頗拉特降。

translations.literal: Passing Aksu, the chief Pilate submitted.
translations.idiomatic: At Aksu chief Pilate surrendered.

sentences.zh: 和闐頭人霍集斯故擒達瓦齊有功，至是亦來附，並招烏什頭人俱降，遂薄葉爾羌。

translations.literal: Khotan chief Khojasi, who had once captured Dawachi with merit, now came over as well, and he also won over the Ush beg, so all submitted and the army pressed on Yarkand.
translations.idiomatic: Khotan chief Khojasi, who had helped capture Dawachi, joined him too, brought in the Ush beg, and with every stronghold yielding they closed on Yarkand.

sentences.zh: 兆惠兵止四百，自烏什至此千五百里，馬行乏，擇要隘屯兵。

translations.literal: Zhaohui had only four hundred men; from Ush to this point was fifteen hundred li, the horses were worn out, and he chose key passes to encamp.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaohui had only four hundred soldiers; from Ush it was fifteen hundred li and the horses were spent, so he camped at vital defiles.

sentences.zh: 霍集占出戰，三敗，保城不復出。

translations.literal: Khoja Jihan came out to fight, was beaten three times, and then held the city and would not come out again.
translations.idiomatic: Khoja Jihan sallied thrice, lost thrice, and then shut himself in the city.

sentences.zh: 兆惠遣副都統愛隆阿以八百人扼喀什噶爾來路阻賊援，而率師臨蔥嶺南河為陣。

translations.literal: Zhaohui sent vice lieutenant-general Ailong'a with eight hundred men to block the Kashgar road against rebel relief while he himself drew up along the southern river of the Congling range.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Ailong'a with eight hundred to choke the Kashgar road against reinforcements and himself formed line along the Congling's southern river.

sentences.zh: 蔥嶺南河者即喀喇烏蘇，譯言黑水，故時謂兆惠軍為黑水營。

translations.literal: The southern Congling river is the Kara Usu—"black water" in translation—so the army was called the Black Water Camp.
translations.idiomatic: That river was the Kara Usu, meaning "black water," whence men called Zhaohui's force the Black Water Camp.

sentences.zh: 兆惠念兵寡而城大，不任攻，諜言賊牧群在城南英峨奇盤山，乃帥輕騎躪其牧地，且致賊為野戰。

translations.literal: Seeing his troops few and the city great, unable to storm it, he spread word that the rebels' herds were on Mount Ying'eqipan south of the city; he led light cavalry to trample the pastures and draw them into open battle.
translations.idiomatic: Knowing he was too few for a siege, he let it be known the enemy's herds grazed on Ying'eqipan south of Yarkand, then led light horse to ruin those pastures and lure them to field battle.

sentences.zh: 渡黑水才四百騎而橋圮，霍集占挾數千騎出，師且戰且涉水，士卒殊死戰，五晝夜殺賊數千人。

translations.literal: He had only four hundred riders when he crossed the Black Water and the bridge gave way; Khoja Jihan came out with several thousand horsemen; the army fought as it waded, the men battled to the death, and in five days and nights several thousand rebels were killed.
translations.idiomatic: Only four hundred horsemen had crossed when the bridge collapsed; Khoja Jihan rushed out with thousands; they fought waist-deep, dying hard, and in five days and nights cut down several thousand rebels.

sentences.zh: 諸將高天喜、鄂實、三格、特通額皆戰死。

translations.literal: The generals Gao Tianxi, Eshi, Sange, and Tetong'e all died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Generals Gao Tianxi, Eshi, Sange, and Tetong'e were killed.

sentences.zh: 兆惠馬再踣，面及脛皆傷，乃收兵築壘掘濠以為衛，賊亦筑壘與我師相持。

translations.literal: Zhaohui's horse fell twice; his face and shins were wounded; he gathered the troops, built ramparts, and dug moats for defense, while the rebels also built works and faced him.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaohui's mount fell twice; face and shins were gashed; he pulled back, threw up walls and ditches, and the rebels threw up works of their own.

sentences.zh: 布拉呢敦自喀什噶爾至，助霍集占困我師。

translations.literal: Burhanuddin came from Kashgar to help Khoja Jihan hem in the imperial army.
translations.idiomatic: Burhanuddin came from Kashgar to help Khoja Jihan tighten the siege.

sentences.zh: 靖逆將軍納穆札爾等帥師赴援，中途遇回兵，力戰，皆死之。

translations.literal: Pacification of Rebellion general Namuzha'er and others led relief troops, met Muslim forces on the way, fought fiercely, and all perished.
translations.idiomatic: Namuzha'er, Pacification of Rebellion general, marched to relieve them, met Muslim troops en route, fought to the end, and was killed with his men.

sentences.zh: 上先事發索倫、察哈爾、健銳營及陝、甘綠旗兵濟兆惠師；

translations.literal: The Emperor had already dispatched Solon, Chahar, Vanguard, and Shaan-Gan Green Standard troops to reinforce Zhaohui;
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor had already sent Solon, Chahar, Vanguard, and Shaan-Gan Green Standard troops to Zhaohui's aid;

sentences.zh: 聞兆惠被圍，促富德赴援，又命阿里袞選戰馬三千送軍前。

translations.literal: hearing he was surrounded, he hurried Fude to the rescue and ordered Ali Gun to choose three thousand war horses for the front.
translations.idiomatic: on news of the encirclement he pressed Fude forward and told Ali Gun to pick three thousand remounts for the army.

sentences.zh: 兆惠發阿克蘇，令舒赫德駐守。

translations.literal: When Zhaohui set out from Aksu he left Shuhede to garrison the place.
translations.idiomatic: Leaving Aksu, Zhaohui stationed Shuhede to hold it.

sentences.zh: 至是遣使令以被圍狀入奏，上獎兆惠統軍深入，忠誠勇敢，進封武毅謀勇一等公，並賜紅寶石帽頂、四團龍補服。

translations.literal: He now sent a messenger to report the siege; the Emperor praised Zhaohui for leading deep with loyalty and courage, raised him to Duke of Martial Resolution and Strategic Courage of the first rank, and gave a ruby hat-knob and four-dragon rank patch.
translations.idiomatic: He now sent word of the siege; the Emperor praised his loyal daring in pushing so far, made him Duke of Martial Resolution and Strategic Courage, first rank, and gave a ruby finial and four-dragon surcoat.

sentences.zh: 霍集占既逼我師為長圍，相持數月。

translations.literal: Khoja Jihan had already pressed the imperial army into a long encirclement that lasted months.
translations.idiomatic: Khoja Jihan had drawn a long cordon around the imperial force and the standoff ran for months.

sentences.zh: 賊自上游引水謀灌我師壘，我師於下游溝而洩之。

translations.literal: The rebels diverted water from upstream to flood our works; our men dug channels downstream and drained it away.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels tried to flood our camp from upstream; we ditched downstream and let the water run off.

sentences.zh: 我師壘迫深林，賊發槍彈著林木中，我師伐為薪，得彈，用以擊賊，常不匱。

translations.literal: Our ramparts backed on deep forest; rebel musket balls lodged in the trees, our men felled the timber for fuel, recovered the balls, and fired them back so ammunition never ran short.
translations.idiomatic: Our walls stood against thick woods; enemy shot lodged in the trunks; we cut firewood, dug out the balls, and shot them back so powder never failed.

sentences.zh: 水不給，賊引水，反得飲，又掘井恆得泉。

translations.literal: Without water, when the enemy led channels we drank from them; wells dug in the ground always struck springs.
translations.idiomatic: Short of water, we drank what they channeled toward us; every well we sank found a spring.

sentences.zh: 發地得藏粟一百六十窖，掠野得馬駝千餘。

translations.literal: Grain caches of a hundred and sixty pits were unearthed, and more than a thousand horses and camels were taken in raids.
translations.idiomatic: We opened a hundred and sixty buried granaries and rounded up over a thousand horses and camels on forays.

sentences.zh: 迫歲暮，圍合已三月，軍中糧漸盡，士卒煮鞍革，甚或掠回民以食。

translations.literal: As the year turned, the siege had lasted three months; army grain was nearly gone, men boiled saddle leather, and some even seized Muslim civilians for food.
translations.idiomatic: By year's end the ring had held three months; rations were almost gone; soldiers boiled harness leather, and some robbed Muslim civilians to eat.

sentences.zh: 布拉呢敦、霍集占以圍久不下，會布魯特掠英吉沙爾，而兆惠即以是日率師焚賊壘，所殺傷過當，疑兆惠與布魯特相約，因遣使入我師請和。

translations.literal: Burhanuddin and Khoja Jihan, unable to break the siege, happened to clash with Kyrgyz raiders at Yengisar; that very day Zhaohui burned the rebel works and killed disproportionately many, so they suspected he had arranged matters with the Kyrgyz and sent envoys into camp to sue for peace.
translations.idiomatic: Unable to break the siege, Burhanuddin and Khoja Jihan were distracted when Kyrgyz raiders struck Yengisar; that same day Zhaohui burned their lines and killed far more than he lost, so they thought he had plotted with the Kyrgyz and sent envoys to treat for peace.

sentences.zh: 兆惠因其使射書諭以納款當入覲，二酋亦射書請撤圍相見。

translations.literal: Zhaohui had his envoys shoot back a letter saying submission meant coming to court; the two chiefs also shot back asking that the siege be lifted for a meeting.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaohui answered by arrow-letter that surrender meant an audience at court; the two chiefs shot back asking to lift the siege for talks.

sentences.zh: 兆惠置不更答，而二酋自此攻稍緩。

translations.literal: Zhaohui gave no further reply, and from then on their attacks slackened.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaohui did not answer again, and their assaults grew weaker.

sentences.zh: 二十四年正月，富德帥師至呼爾璊，遇回兵，轉戰五晝夜。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twenty-fourth year Fude led the army to Hurgan, met Muslim troops, and fought five days and nights.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 24 Fude brought his column to Hurgan, met Muslim forces, and battled five days and nights.

sentences.zh: 阿里袞送馬至，合軍复戰。

translations.literal: Ali Gun delivered horses; the combined army fought again.
translations.idiomatic: Ali Gun arrived with horses; united, they fought on.

sentences.zh: 布拉呢敦出戰，中彈傷，還喀什噶爾。

translations.literal: Burhanuddin came out, was wounded by gunfire, and returned to Kashgar.
translations.idiomatic: Burhanuddin sallied, took a musket wound, and withdrew to Kashgar.

sentences.zh: 師至葉爾羌河岸，阿里袞與愛隆阿合軍為右翼，富德及舒赫德為左翼，逐賊，以次徐進。

translations.literal: When the army reached the Yarkand riverbank, Ali Gun and Ailong'a formed the right wing, Fude and Shuhede the left, and they drove the enemy, advancing step by step.
translations.idiomatic: At the Yarkand river Ali Gun and Ailong'a held the right, Fude and Shuhede the left, and they pushed the enemy back inch by inch.

sentences.zh: 兆惠自圍中望見火光十餘裡，馬駝群囂塵上，知援集，乃率餘軍破壘出，與諸軍相合，引還阿克蘇。

translations.literal: Zhaohui inside the siege saw firelight for more than ten li, dust rising from herds of horses and camels, knew relief had come, broke out with his remaining troops, joined the armies, and withdrew to Aksu.
translations.idiomatic: Inside the ring Zhaohui saw fires for ten li and dust from horse and camel herds, knew help had come, broke out with what men he had left, met the relief, and fell back to Aksu.

sentences.zh: 上為賦黑水行紀其事。

translations.literal: The Emperor composed the "Black Water Campaign" to commemorate it.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor wrote the "Black Water Campaign" to mark the feat.

sentences.zh: 兆惠疏辭進封及章服，諭毋辭，並以其母老，時遣人存問。

translations.literal: Zhaohui declined the new enfeoffment and insignia in a memorial; he was told not to refuse, and because his mother was old the court sent people to inquire after her.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaohui tried to decline the new title and robes; the throne told him to accept and, as his mother was aged, sent agents to visit her.

sentences.zh: 霍集占之黨攻和闐，上以兆惠、富德既合軍急引還，謂富德不得以援兆惠為畢事，兆惠為帥被圍待援，尤不當遽引師​​退。

translations.literal: When Khoja Jihan's faction attacked Khotan, the Emperor, because Zhaohui and Fude had united and withdrawn in haste, said Fude must not treat rescuing Zhaohui as the whole task and that Zhaohui as commander, besieged and waiting for relief, especially should not pull back so soon.
translations.idiomatic: Khoja Jihan's allies struck Khotan; the Emperor, seeing Zhaohui and Fude join up and retreat quickly, said Fude must not think aiding Zhaohui finished the war and that Zhaohui, as commander trapped and awaiting rescue, above all should not have withdrawn so soon.

sentences.zh: 諭趣富德援和闐，兆惠當就現在兵力加意奮勉，以竟全功。

translations.literal: He ordered Fude to hurry to Khotan and told Zhaohui to press on with the force at hand and finish the work.
translations.idiomatic: He pressed Fude toward Khotan and told Zhaohui to drive hard with what troops he had and complete the victory.

sentences.zh: 兆惠督諸將分道進攻，布拉呢敦棄喀什噶爾，霍集占亦棄葉爾羌同遁。

translations.literal: Zhaohui directed the generals in separate attacks; Burhanuddin abandoned Kashgar and Khoja Jihan fled Yarkand together.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaohui sent his generals on divided columns; Burhanuddin quit Kashgar and Khoja Jihan fled Yarkand with him.

sentences.zh: 兆惠師至喀什噶爾，撫定餘眾，富德亦收葉爾羌，為畫疆界，定貢賦，鑄泉幣，並分屯滿、漢兵駐守。

translations.literal: Zhaohui reached Kashgar and pacified the remnant population; Fude took Yarkand, they drew borders, fixed tribute, cast coin, and posted Manchu and Chinese garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaohui entered Kashgar and settled the people; Fude held Yarkand; they fixed borders, tribute, coinage, and Manchu-Chinese garrisons.

sentences.zh: 富德師復進，追及霍集占，戰於阿勒楚爾，再戰於伊西洱庫爾淖爾。

translations.literal: Fude's column advanced again, overtook Khoja Jihan, and fought at Aletuer and again at Yixihur Lake.
translations.idiomatic: Fude pushed on, caught Khoja Jihan, and fought at Aletuer and again at Yixihur Lake.

sentences.zh: 布拉呢敦、霍集占竄入巴達克山，師從之。

translations.literal: Burhanuddin and Khoja Jihan fled into Badakhshan and the army followed.
translations.idiomatic: Burhanuddin and Khoja Jihan slipped into Badakhshan, and the army went after them.

sentences.zh: 巴達克山汗素勒坦沙初言霍集占中彈死，生獲布拉呢敦；

translations.literal: The Badakhshan khan Sultan Shah at first said Khoja Jihan had died of a gunshot wound and that Burhanuddin had been taken alive;
translations.idiomatic: Badakhshan khan Sultan Shah first reported Khoja Jihan shot dead and Burhanuddin captured alive;

sentences.zh: 復言兩酋已皆死，獻霍集占首。

translations.literal: he then said both chiefs were dead and presented Khoja Jihan's head.
translations.idiomatic: he later said both leaders were dead and sent Khoja Jihan's head.

sentences.zh: 上加兆惠宗室公品級、鞍轡，並授其子侍衛。

translations.literal: The Emperor raised Zhaohui to the rank of a banner prince of the imperial clan, gave saddle trappings, and appointed his son a bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: The throne raised Zhaohui to imperial-clan duke rank, gave him court harness, and made his son a bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 兆惠复撫定霍罕額爾德尼伯克所屬四城，並齊哩克布魯特、額德格納布魯特、阿濟畢部眾，請留兵分駐葉爾羌、喀什噶爾諸城。

translations.literal: Zhaohui again pacified the four cities under the Kokand erdeni beg, the Qilik Kyrgyz, the Edegena Kyrgyz, and the Aq Bibi tribes, and asked to leave troops garrisoned at Yarkand, Kashgar, and other towns.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaohui settled the four Kokand cities and the Qilik, Edegena, and Aq Bibi peoples, and asked for divided garrisons at Yarkand, Kashgar, and the rest.

sentences.zh: 复定各城伯克更番入覲例。

translations.literal: He also fixed the rotating schedule by which each city beg should come to court.
translations.idiomatic: He also set the rotation under which city begs would attend court.

sentences.zh: 二十五年二月，師還，上幸良鄉，於城南行郊勞禮。

translations.literal: In the second month of the twenty-fifth year the army returned; the Emperor visited Liangxiang and performed the suburban reward rite south of the city.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year 25 the army came home; the Emperor went to Liangxiang and held the suburban welcome south of the town.

sentences.zh: 兆惠入謁，賜朝珠及馬，從上還京。

translations.literal: Zhaohui had an audience, was given court beads and a horse, and returned to the capital with the Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaohui was received in audience, given court beads and a horse, and rode back to Beijing with the Emperor.

sentences.zh: 飲至，賚銀幣。

translations.literal: At the feast to the troops he was rewarded with silver cash.
translations.idiomatic: At the victory feast he received silver cash.

sentences.zh: 圖形紫光閣。

translations.literal: His portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor.
translations.idiomatic: His likeness was painted in the Hall of Purple Splendor.

sentences.zh: 二十六年七月，命協辦大學士，兼領刑部。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the twenty-sixth year he was ordered to serve as associate grand secretary while also heading Justice.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of year 26 he was made associate grand secretary and put in charge of Justice.

sentences.zh: 旋令偕大學士劉統勳按楊橋河決。

translations.literal: He was soon told to join Grand Secretary Liu Tongxun in investigating the Yangqiao River breach.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was sent with Grand Secretary Liu Tongxun to deal with the Yangqiao River break.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，复偕統勳勘江南運河。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year he again joined Tongxun in surveying the Jiangnan Grand Canal.
translations.idiomatic: In year 27 he again surveyed the Jiangnan Grand Canal with Tongxun.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，直隸水災，命勘海口，疏天津、靜海諸縣水道。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, when Zhili suffered floods, he was ordered to inspect the sea mouth and open waterways in Tianjin, Jinghai, and other counties.
translations.idiomatic: In year 28, after Zhili floods, he inspected the estuary and dredged channels in Tianjin, Jinghai, and neighboring counties.

sentences.zh: 復命偕兩江總督尹繼善籌濬荊山橋河道。

translations.literal: He was again ordered with Liangjiang governor Yin Jishan to plan dredging the Jingshan Bridge reach.
translations.idiomatic: He was again paired with Liangjiang governor Yin Jishan to dredge the Jingshan Bridge section.

sentences.zh: 二十九年十一月，卒。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the twenty-ninth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the eleventh month of year 29.

sentences.zh: 上臨其喪，贈太保，諡文襄。

translations.literal: The Emperor attended his mourning, posthumously made him Grand Tutor, and gave the posthumous name Wenxiang.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor came to his funeral, posthumously named him Grand Tutor, and gave the temple name Wenxiang.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年十一月，命配享太廟。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the first year of Jiaqing he was ordered enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of Jiaqing 1 he was ordered a share in sacrifices at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 子扎蘭泰，尚高宗女和碩和恪公主，襲爵，授額駙。

translations.literal: His son Zhalantai married the Gaozong princess Heshuo Ke, inherited the title, and was made an imperial son-in-law.
translations.idiomatic: His son Zhalantai married Princess Heshuo Ke of Gaozong, inherited the rank, and became an imperial son-in-law.

sentences.zh: 阿里袞，字松崖，鈕祜祿氏，滿洲正白旗人，尹德第四子，而訥親弟也。

translations.literal: Ali Gun, style name Songya, of the Niohuru clan, was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner, the fourth son of Yinde and younger brother of Neqin.
translations.idiomatic: Ali Gun, styled Songya, of the Niohuru clan, was a Plain White Banner Manchu, Yinde fourth son and Neqin younger brother.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，自二等侍衛授總管內務府大臣。

translations.literal: Early in Qianlong he rose from second-class bodyguard to superintendent of the Imperial Household Department.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Qianlong he went from second-class bodyguard to head of the Imperial Household.

sentences.zh: 遷侍郎，歷兵、戶二部。

translations.literal: He was promoted to vice minister and served in War and Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He became a vice minister and passed through War and Revenue.

sentences.zh: 五年，命與僉都御史硃必堦如山東勘巡撫碩色報歉收失實狀。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was ordered with censor Zhu Bikai to go to Shandong and investigate whether Governor Shuo Se had falsely reported harvest shortfalls.
translations.idiomatic: In year 5 he and censor Zhu Bikai were sent to Shandong to check Governor Shuo Se crop reports.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「蘭山、郯城被水最甚，請緩徵新、舊賦，而以官帑市穀補社倉。」

translations.literal: He memorialized: Lanshan and Tancheng suffered the worst flooding; please defer both old and new taxes and use treasury grain to refill the community granaries.
translations.idiomatic: He wrote: Lanshan and Tancheng were hardest hit—defer old and new taxes and refill the community granaries from the treasury.

sentences.zh: 復命與江南河道總督高斌如江西勘巡撫岳濬等徇情納賄狀，鞫實，濬坐黜。

translations.literal: He was again ordered with Jiangnan canal director Gao Bin to go to Jiangxi and investigate whether Governor Yue Jun and others had taken bribes through favoritism; the facts were proved and Jun was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent again with canal director Gao Bin to Jiangxi to prove Governor Yue Jun bribery; Jun was removed.

sentences.zh: 六年，侍郎梁詩正奏八旗兵丁當分置邊屯，復命與大學士查郎阿如奉天相度地勢。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, when Vice Minister Liang Shizheng proposed resettling Eight Banner soldiers on frontier farms, he was again ordered with Grand Secretary Zhalanga to survey the terrain in Fengtian.
translations.idiomatic: In year 6, after Liang Shizheng urged frontier farms for bannermen, he and Grand Secretary Zhalanga surveyed Fengtian.

sentences.zh: 上言：「地宜耕者，吉林烏拉東北拉林、阿爾楚克，阿爾楚哈東飛克圖，齊齊哈爾東南呼蘭，西南黑爾蘇站、刷煙站，白都訥東八家子至登額爾者庫，皆沃壤；

translations.literal: He reported: Land fit for farming includes, northeast of Jilin Ula, Lalin and Aertuke; east of Aertuha, Feiketu; southeast of Qiqihar, Hulan; southwest of Qiqihar, Heiersu and Shuayan stations; from east of Baidunai through Bajiazi to Denggeerzheku—all rich soil;
translations.idiomatic: He listed arable tracts: Lalin and Aertuke northeast of Jilin Ula; Feiketu east of Aertuha; Hulan southeast of Qiqihar; Heiersu and Shuayan southwest of Qiqihar; Bajiazi to Denggeerzheku east of Baidunai—all fertile;

sentences.zh: 呼蘭東佛忒喜素素富林木，惟地高下各異。

translations.literal: east of Hulan, Fotexi Susu has rich timber, though the ground rises and falls.
translations.idiomatic: east of Hulan, Fotexi Susu has good timber though the ground is uneven.

sentences.zh: 墨爾根寒暑早，齊齊哈爾砂磧，吉林烏拉無餘地，寧古塔山深，烏蘇里產葠，皆不宜耕。」

translations.literal: Moergen has early cold, Qiqihar is gravelly, Jilin Ula has no spare land, Ningguta is mountainous, Wusuli grows ginseng—all unsuitable for farming.
translations.idiomatic: Moergen is too cold, Qiqihar too stony, Jilin Ula too full, Ningguta too steep, Wusuli ginseng country—all poor for farming.

sentences.zh: 議政王大臣用其議，移屯自拉林、阿爾楚哈始。

translations.literal: The princes and ministers in council adopted his plan, and resettlement began at Lalin and Aertuha.
translations.idiomatic: The council took his advice and opened farms from Lalin and Aertuha.

sentences.zh: 八年，命如湖南勘巡撫許容劾糧道謝濟世狂縱狀，白濟世枉。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was sent to Hunan to investigate Governor Xu Rong charge that grain intendant Xie Jishi was insolent; he cleared Jishi.
translations.idiomatic: In year 8 he went to Hunan on Xu Rong charge against intendant Xie Jishi and cleared Jishi.

sentences.zh: 命即署巡撫，歷河南、山西、山東諸省。

translations.literal: He was immediately made acting governor and served in Henan, Shanxi, and Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: He was made acting governor and served Henan, Shanxi, and Shandong.

sentences.zh: 十四年，訥親誅，令分任訥親償帑。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, when Neqin was executed, he was ordered to share paying Neqin indemnity.
translations.idiomatic: In year 14, after Neqin execution, he was told to help pay Neqin fine.

sentences.zh: 旋以兄弟不相及，命免之。

translations.literal: Soon, on the principle that brothers should not be implicated, the order was waived.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the court ruled brothers should not share guilt and released him.

sentences.zh: 上將巡五台，阿里袞疏請於台懷建行宮，太原就巡撫署增建群室，上不許。

translations.literal: When the Emperor was to tour Wutai, Ali Gun asked to build a palace at Taihuai and add rooms at the Taiyuan governor yamen; the Emperor refused.
translations.idiomatic: Before a Wutai tour he asked for a palace at Taihuai and extra rooms at Taiyuan; the Emperor said no.

sentences.zh: 阿里袞別疏薦參將傅謙，大學士傅恆弟也，上責其不當，詔切責。

translations.literal: Ali Gun separately recommended Major Fu Qian, younger brother of Grand Secretary Fu Heng; the Emperor rebuked him as improper and issued a stern edict.
translations.idiomatic: He also pushed Major Fu Qian, Fu Heng brother; the Emperor scolded him and issued a sharp edict.

sentences.zh: 十五年，授湖廣總督。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he was made governor-general of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: In year 15 he became governor-general of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 湖北巡撫唐綏祖為前總督永興劾罷，阿里袞白綏祖無受賕狀，永興坐黜。

translations.literal: Hubei governor Tang Suizu had been impeached and removed by the former governor Yongxing; Ali Gun reported Suizu had taken no bribes and Yongxing was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Hubei governor Tang Suizu had been ousted by ex-governor Yongxing; Ali Gun showed Suizu took no bribes and Yongxing fell.

sentences.zh: 十六年，移兩廣總督。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he was transferred to governor-general of Liangguang.
translations.idiomatic: In year 16 he moved to Liangguang.

sentences.zh: 東莞民莫信豐謀為亂，討平之。

translations.literal: The Dongguan commoner Mo Xinfeng plotted rebellion; Ali Gun suppressed it.
translations.idiomatic: Dongguan Mo Xinfeng rose in revolt; Ali Gun put it down.

sentences.zh: 尋居母憂，還京師。

translations.literal: Soon, while mourning his mother, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: He soon went into mourning for his mother and returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 授戶部侍郎，擢​​尚書，歷刑、工、戶三部，兼鑲白旗漢軍都統。

translations.literal: He was made vice minister of Revenue, then promoted to minister, passing through Punishments, Works, and Revenue, and also lieutenant-general of the Bordered White Chinese Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He became Revenue vice minister, then minister through Punishments, Works, and Revenue, and Bordered White Chinese lieutenant-general.

sentences.zh: 二十一年四月，命軍機處行走。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the twenty-first year he was ordered to serve at the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of year 21 he was put on the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 時上方責諸將逐捕阿睦爾撒納，定西將軍達爾黨阿出西路。

translations.literal: At that time the Emperor was reproaching the generals for failing to catch Amursana, and Dingxi general Dardanga marched out on the western route.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor was pressing generals to catch Amursana; Dingxi general Dardanga took the western road.

sentences.zh: 五月，命阿里袞佐達爾黨阿，在領隊大臣上行走。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Ali Gun was ordered to assist Dardanga, serving above the expedition leaders.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Ali Gun was told to aid Dardanga with rank above the column leaders.

sentences.zh: 九月，師至雅爾拉，遇賊再胜。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the army reached Yarlai and twice defeated the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the army reached Yarlai and beat the enemy twice.

sentences.zh: 十月，命與達爾黨阿還京師。

translations.literal: In the tenth month he was ordered back to the capital with Dardanga.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month he and Dardanga were recalled to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 二十二年正月，上以成袞扎佈為定邊左副將軍，會師巴里坤，阿里袞仍在領隊大臣上行走。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twenty-second year the Emperor made Chengun Zhabu western left deputy general; the armies united at Barkul, and Ali Gun still served above the expedition leaders.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 22 Chengun Zhabu became western left deputy; armies met at Barkul and Ali Gun kept his senior post.

sentences.zh: 二月，達爾黨阿以失阿睦爾撒納削爵，阿里袞亦坐降戶部侍郎，旋兼正白旗蒙古副都統。

translations.literal: In the second month Dardanga lost his title for letting Amursana escape; Ali Gun was also demoted to Revenue vice minister, then made Manchu deputy lieutenant-general of the Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Dardanga was stripped for losing Amursana; Ali Gun was cut to Revenue vice minister, then Plain White Manchu deputy lieutenant-general.

sentences.zh: 時回部大和卓木布拉呢敦、小和卓木霍集占分據葉爾羌、喀什噶爾為亂，於是沙拉斯、瑪呼斯諸部游牧與相應。

translations.literal: At that time the Muslim Great Khoja Burhanuddin and Lesser Khoja Khoja Jihan held Yarkand and Kashgar in revolt, and the Sharas and Mahus nomads rose with them.
translations.idiomatic: Then Great Khoja Burhanuddin and Lesser Khoja Khoja Jihan held Yarkand and Kashgar, and Sharas and Mahus nomads joined them.

sentences.zh: 九月，阿里袞與都統滿福自阿斯罕布拉克、和什特哷克取道至哈喇沙爾，搜山殺敵。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Ali Gun with commandant Manfu marched from Ashanbulak and Hoshtok to Karashar, scouring the hills and killing the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Ali Gun and Manfu went from Ashanbulak and Hoshtok to Karashar, hunting rebels in the hills.

sentences.zh: 復進至塔本順和爾、納木噶，俘男婦二百餘。

translations.literal: They advanced to Tabun Shunghur and Namuga and captured more than two hundred men and women.
translations.idiomatic: They pushed to Tabun Shunghur and Namuga and took over two hundred captives.

sentences.zh: 十二月，滿福為郭多克哈什哈誘戕，沙拉斯、瑪呼斯遁庫車諸處。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Manfu was lured and killed by Guodok Hasha; Sharas and Mahus fled toward Kucha.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Manfu was ambushed and killed by Guodok Hasha; Sharas and Mahus fled toward Kucha.

sentences.zh: 阿里袞復進次哈喇沙爾西南庫爾勒。

translations.literal: Ali Gun advanced again and camped southwest of Karashar at Korla.
translations.idiomatic: Ali Gun moved on and camped at Korla, southwest of Karashar.

sentences.zh: 二十三年正月，復進逐敵至呼爾塔克山，獲瑪呼斯得木齊額默根等。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twenty-third year he again pursued the enemy to Mount Hurktak and captured Mahus Demuqi Ermugen and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 23 he chased the enemy to Mount Hurktak and seized Mahus Demuqi Ermugen and others.

sentences.zh: 四月，阿里袞自魯克察還師，駐巴里坤。

translations.literal: In the fourth month Ali Gun withdrew from Lukqi and garrisoned Barkul.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month he pulled back from Lukqi to Barkul.

sentences.zh: 上先得伯克素賚瑪奏，阿里袞方搜捕瑪哈沁將還師，與阿里袞疏言師向呼爾塔克山不相應，上因責阿里袞中途遷延，罷侍郎，以副都統革職留任。

translations.literal: The Emperor had first received beg Suerma report that Ali Gun was searching for Mahujin and about to return, which did not match Ali Gun memorial that the army was heading for Mount Hurktak; the Emperor therefore rebuked Ali Gun for delay on the march, removed him from the vice ministership, and kept him at reduced rank as vice lieutenant-general.
translations.idiomatic: Beg Suerma said Ali Gun was rounding up Mahujin and turning back, but Ali Gun wrote he was bound for Mount Hurktak; the Emperor blamed the delay, stripped his vice ministership, and kept him on as demoted vice lieutenant-general.

sentences.zh: 六月，靖逆將軍雅爾哈善攻庫車，霍集占赴援，入城守，已，复走還葉爾羌。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Pacification of Rebellion general Yarhashan attacked Kucha; Khoja Jihan went to relieve it, entered the city to defend, then fled back to Yarkand.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Yarhashan besieged Kucha; Khoja Jihan relieved it, held the city, then fled to Yarkand.

sentences.zh: 上為罷雅爾哈善，而督定邊將軍兆惠攻阿克蘇，遂進逼葉爾羌。

translations.literal: The Emperor dismissed Yarhashan and urged Pacification general Zhaohui to take Aksu and press on Yarkand.
translations.idiomatic: Yarhashan was removed; the Emperor pushed Zhaohui through Aksu toward Yarkand.

sentences.zh: 十一月，命阿里袞選馬三千、駝七百益兆惠軍。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Ali Gun was ordered to choose three thousand horses and seven hundred camels to reinforce Zhaohui.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he was told to send Zhaohui three thousand horses and seven hundred camels.

sentences.zh: 兆惠攻葉爾羌不克，瀕黑水結寨，霍集占為長圍困之。

translations.literal: Zhaohui could not take Yarkand, camped by the Black Water, and Khoja Jihan drew a long siege around him.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaohui failed at Yarkand, made camp on the Black Water, and Khoja Jihan penned him in.

sentences.zh: 上聞，授富德定邊右將軍、阿里袞參贊大臣，援兆惠。

translations.literal: When word reached the throne, Fude was made western right general and Ali Gun campaign commissioner to relieve Zhaohui.
translations.idiomatic: On news of the siege Fude became western right general and Ali Gun commissioner to save Zhaohui.

sentences.zh: 是月命襲封二等公。

translations.literal: That month he was ordered to inherit a second-class duke.
translations.idiomatic: That month he was told to inherit a second-class dukedom.

sentences.zh: 十二月，授兵部尚書、正紅旗蒙古都統。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he was made minister of War and Mongol lieutenant-general of the Plain Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he became War minister and Plain Red Mongol lieutenant-general.

sentences.zh: 二十四年正月，富德師至呼爾璊，霍集占出戰，五日四夜未決。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twenty-fourth year Fude army reached Hurgan; Khoja Jihan came out to fight and for five days and four nights the battle was undecided.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 24 Fude reached Hurgan; Khoja Jihan fought five days and four nights without decision.

sentences.zh: 阿里袞以駝馬至，乘夜分師為兩翼斫陣，斬千餘級。

translations.literal: When Ali Gun arrived with camels and horses he split the force into two wings by night and cut the enemy line, beheading more than a thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Ali Gun came with pack animals, divided into night wings, and hacked the line, taking a thousand heads.

sentences.zh: 布拉呢敦中創，與霍集占並敗走。

translations.literal: Burhanuddin was wounded and fled with Khoja Jihan.
translations.idiomatic: Burhanuddin was hit and fled with Khoja Jihan.

sentences.zh: 援兆惠全師以還。

translations.literal: They relieved Zhaohui and brought the whole army back.
translations.idiomatic: They broke Zhaohui out and brought the whole force back.

sentences.zh: 上以阿里袞送馬濟軍，如期集事，且殺賊多，加雲騎尉世職，例進一等公。

translations.literal: Because Ali Gun had delivered horses on time, gathered as ordered, and killed many rebels, he was given a hereditary Cloud Cavalry Captaincy and advanced one step in duke rank.
translations.idiomatic: For timely horses, timely muster, and heavy kills he received a hereditary Cloud Cavalry Captaincy and a step up in rank.

sentences.zh: 七月，霍集占走巴達克山部，阿里袞與富德等帥師從之，降其眾萬二千有奇。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Khoja Jihan fled to Badakhshan; Ali Gun with Fude and others followed, accepting the surrender of more than twelve thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Khoja Jihan fled to Badakhshan; Ali Gun and Fude followed and took over twelve thousand surrenders.

sentences.zh: 阿里袞以五百人駐伊西勒庫爾淖爾西截隘，復分兵出其南，遇敵，奪其家屬輜重，降二千有奇。

translations.literal: Ali Gun stationed five hundred men west of Yixilekur Lake to block the passes, then sent detachments south, met the enemy, seized families and baggage, and accepted more than two thousand surrenders.
translations.idiomatic: He blocked the passes west of Yixilekur Lake with five hundred, sent columns south, seized families and baggage, and took two thousand more.

sentences.zh: 復將選兵二百踰​​嶺逐敵。

translations.literal: He again chose two hundred men to cross the ridge in pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: He picked two hundred more to cross the ridge after them.

sentences.zh: 巴達克山部旋納款，以霍集占首獻。

translations.literal: Badakhshan soon submitted and presented Khoja Jihan head.
translations.idiomatic: Badakhshan soon submitted and sent Khoja Jihan head.

sentences.zh: 行賞，賜阿里袞雙眼孔雀翎。

translations.literal: In the distribution of rewards Ali Gun was given a double-eyed peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: When rewards were given he received a double-eyed peacock plume.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，召還京師。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year he was recalled to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In year 25 he was recalled to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 六月，自喀什噶爾行次葉爾羌，會雅木扎爾回酋邁喇木煽訛謂阿睦爾撒納復入阿克蘇，群起為亂。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, marching from Kashgar and stopping at Yarkand, he learned the Yarkand Muslim chief Mailamu had spread rumors that Amursana had re-entered Aksu and stirred a general rising.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, between Kashgar and Yarkand, he heard Mailamu was saying Amursana had returned to Aksu and the country was rising.

sentences.zh: 乃復還喀什噶爾，率八百人以出，至伯什克勒木，邁喇木等以千餘人拒戰，阿里袞督所部擊破之。

translations.literal: He turned back to Kashgar, led eight hundred men out to Beshiklemu, and when Mailamu and more than a thousand men resisted, Ali Gun directed his troops and broke them.
translations.idiomatic: He swung back to Kashgar, took eight hundred to Beshiklemu, and when Mailamu met him with a thousand men he smashed them.

sentences.zh: 賊入城堅守，麾兵合圍，夜四鼓，城人呼號乞降，邁喇木遁去。

translations.literal: The rebels entered the city and held firm; he ordered a full encirclement; at the fourth watch the townspeople cried out begging to surrender and Mailamu escaped.
translations.idiomatic: They shut themselves in the city; he encircled it; at the fourth watch the people begged to yield and Mailamu fled.

sentences.zh: 上獎阿里袞應機立辦，授其子拜唐阿豐升額藍翎侍衛。

translations.literal: The Emperor praised Ali Gun for handling the crisis on the spot and made his son Baitang-a Fengshenge a blue-plume bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor praised his quick handling and made his son Baitang-a Fengshenge a blue-plume guard.

sentences.zh: 阿里袞旋捕邁喇木等送京師，復進豐升額三等侍衛，授其次子倭興額藍翎侍衛。

translations.literal: Ali Gun soon captured Mailamu and others and sent them to the capital; Fengshenge was raised to third-class bodyguard and his second son Weixinge was made a blue-plume bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: He soon sent Mailamu to court; Fengshenge rose to third-class guard and second son Weixinge got a blue plume.

sentences.zh: 十月，阿里袞還京師，授領侍衛內大臣，圖形紫光閣。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Ali Gun returned to the capital, was made grand minister of the inner guard, and his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month he came home, became inner guard grand minister, and joined the Purple Splendor portraits.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，加太子太保。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year he was made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In year 28 he was made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，授戶部尚書、協辦大學士。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year he was made minister of Revenue and associate grand secretary.
translations.idiomatic: In year 29 he became Revenue minister and associate grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 時緬甸亂，南徼兵連數歲。

translations.literal: At that time Burma was in turmoil and fighting on the southern frontier had gone on for years.
translations.idiomatic: Burma was in revolt and the southern frontier had seen years of war.

sentences.zh: 三十一年春，將軍明瑞深入，上授阿里袞參贊大臣，馳傳至軍。

translations.literal: In the spring of the thirty-first year, when General Ming Rui pushed deep, the Emperor made Ali Gun campaign commissioner and sent him post-haste to the army.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of year 31, as Ming Rui advanced deep, the Emperor made Ali Gun commissioner and rushed him to the front.

sentences.zh: 二月，明瑞戰死猛臘，大學士傅恆出為經略，授阿里袞及阿桂為副將軍，並令暫領雲貴總督，率師駐永昌。

translations.literal: In the second month Ming Rui died fighting at Mengla; Grand Secretary Fu Heng became campaign commander, Ali Gun and A Gui were made deputy generals, and he was told temporarily to head the Yunnan-Guizhou governorship and hold the army at Yongchang.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Ming Rui fell at Mengla; Fu Heng took command; Ali Gun and A Gui became deputies; he also acted as Yunnan-Guizhou governor at Yongchang.

sentences.zh: 朝議：「明年進兵。

translations.literal: Court debate ran: Advance next year.
translations.idiomatic: Court debate said: Strike next year.

sentences.zh: 今歲秋夏瘴退，先收普洱、思茅邊外諸小部落。」

translations.literal: This autumn and summer, when the miasma lifts, first take the small tribes outside Puer and Simao.
translations.idiomatic: This autumn and summer, when fever fades, take the small tribes outside Puer and Simao first.

sentences.zh: 阿里袞疏言：​​「邊外十三板納皆內屬不為亂，惟召散、整貝、猛勇三部附緬甸。」

translations.literal: Ali Gun memorialized: Of the thirteen banna beyond the border all submit except Zhao San, Zhengbei, and Mengyong, who side with Burma.
translations.idiomatic: Ali Gun wrote: All thirteen frontier banna obey except Zhao San, Zhengbei, and Mengyong, who follow Burma.

sentences.zh: 當用兵時，刑部尚書舒赫德在軍，與雲南巡撫鄂寧密疏議撫。

translations.literal: When war was decided, Justice minister Shuhede was in the army and with Yunnan governor Eshi secretly memorialized for peace.
translations.idiomatic: As war began, Shuhede at the front and Governor Eshi secretly urged peace.

sentences.zh: 六月，緬甸使頭人請款，阿里袞拒之，以聞。

translations.literal: In the sixth month a Burmese envoy asked to treat; Ali Gun refused and reported up.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month a Burmese envoy sued for peace; Ali Gun refused and reported.

sentences.zh: 上命置毋答，並譴舒赫德等。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered no reply and rebuked Shuhede and the others.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor told them to ignore it and scolded Shuhede and the rest.

sentences.zh: 七月，阿里袞疏請絕緬甸貿易，並治雲南省城至永昌道，撫慰沿邊諸土司，借帑俾市籽種牛具，皆得俞旨。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Ali Gun asked to cut Burma trade, repair the road from Yunnan city to Yongchang, soothe frontier chiefs, and lend grain for seed and oxen—all approved.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month he asked to stop Burma trade, fix the Yunnan–Yongchang road, soothe chiefs, and lend grain for seed and cattle—all granted.

sentences.zh: 十二月，阿桂兵至，共發兵出邊，未深入而還。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month A Gui troops arrived; they sent forces across the border but did not push deep before returning.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month A Gui came; they crossed the border but withdrew without a deep push.

sentences.zh: 三十四年二月，上摘雲貴總督明德疏語，以軍中馬羸責阿里袞等，下部議奪職，命寬之。

translations.literal: In the second month of the thirty-fourth year the Emperor, quoting phrases from Governor Mingde memorial, blamed Ali Gun and others for weak horses in the army; the ministry recommended stripping rank, but the order was lenient.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year 34 the Emperor, citing Mingde memorial, blamed weak army horses; the ministry wanted rank stripped but mercy was shown.

sentences.zh: 三月，傅恆至軍，與阿里袞等議進兵渡戛鳩江，西攻猛拱、猛養兩土司，向阿瓦。

translations.literal: In the third month Fu Heng reached the army and with Ali Gun and others planned to cross the Jiayu River, strike west at the Menggong and Mengyang chiefs, and march on Ava.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Fu Heng arrived; they planned to cross the Jiayu, hit Menggong and Mengyang, and march on Ava.

sentences.zh: 阿瓦，緬甸都也。

translations.literal: Ava was the Burmese capital.
translations.idiomatic: Ava was Burma capital.

sentences.zh: 偏師至猛密，夾江而下，造舟蠻暮通往來。

translations.literal: A flank column would reach Mengmi and move down both banks of the river, building boats at Manmu for traffic.
translations.idiomatic: A flank would reach Mengmi, descend both banks, and build boats at Manmu.

sentences.zh: 七月，師行。

translations.literal: In the seventh month the army marched.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month the army moved.

sentences.zh: 初，阿里袞病瘍，上遣醫就視良愈，至是復大作。

translations.literal: Earlier Ali Gun had suffered from ulcers; the Emperor sent a physician and he recovered, but now the illness flared again.
translations.idiomatic: He had had ulcers; a doctor cured him, but now they returned severely.

sentences.zh: 傅恆令留永昌治疾，阿里袞堅請行。

translations.literal: Fu Heng ordered him to stay at Yongchang to treat his illness, but Ali Gun insisted on marching.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Heng told him to remain at Yongchang for treatment, but Ali Gun insisted on going forward.

sentences.zh: 師進，緬甸兵不出。

translations.literal: The army advanced, but the Burmese troops did not come out.
translations.idiomatic: The column moved on, yet Burmese forces stayed in cover.

sentences.zh: 十月，傅恆還師蠻暮，復進攻老官屯，駐戛鳩江口。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Fu Heng withdrew to Manmu, then advanced again to attack Laoguantun and camped at the Jiayu River mouth.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Fu Heng fell back to Manmu, struck Laoguantun again, and camped at the Jiayu mouth.

sentences.zh: 緬甸兵水陸並至，傅恆、阿桂軍江東，阿里袞軍江西，迎戰。

translations.literal: Burmese troops came by land and water; Fu Heng and A Gui held the east bank, Ali Gun the west, and met the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Burmese came by land and water; Fu Heng and A Gui fought east of the river, Ali Gun west.

sentences.zh: 敵結寨自固，阿里袞率兵七百攻之，敵百餘棄寨走。

translations.literal: The enemy fortified a stockade; Ali Gun led seven hundred men to attack it and more than a hundred abandoned the works and fled.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy walled a camp; Ali Gun hit it with seven hundred; a hundred rebels fled.

sentences.zh: 把總姚卓殺敵，奪其旗，師銳進，敵四百餘亦遁。

translations.literal: Sergeant Yao Zhuo killed the enemy and seized their banner; the army pressed on sharply and another four hundred also fled.
translations.idiomatic: Sergeant Yao Zhuo slew the foe and took their flag; the troops rushed on and four hundred more ran.

sentences.zh: 复戰，會日暮，敵不能堅守，皆引去。

translations.literal: They fought again, but dusk fell; the enemy could not hold and all withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Another clash followed; at dusk the enemy broke and left.

sentences.zh: 凡破寨三，殺敵五百餘。

translations.literal: In all three stockades were taken and more than five hundred enemies killed.
translations.idiomatic: Three camps fell and over five hundred were killed.

sentences.zh: 傅恆亦遘疾，諸將議毋更進兵，阿里袞曰：「老官屯賊寨，前歲額爾登額攻未克。

translations.literal: Fu Heng also fell ill; the generals debated whether to advance further; Ali Gun said: The Laoguantun rebel stockade was attacked last year by Erdenge without success.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Heng grew ill; generals argued against going on; Ali Gun said Laoguantun had beaten Erdenge the year before.

sentences.zh: 距此僅一舍，不破之何以報命？」

translations.literal: It is only one stage from here—if we do not break it, how can we answer our orders?
translations.idiomatic: It lies only one march away—if we fail to take it, how do we answer the throne?

sentences.zh: 策馬行，傅恆以下皆從之，寨堅，攻不克。

translations.literal: He spurred his horse forward; Fu Heng and the rest followed; the stockade was strong and the attack failed.
translations.idiomatic: He rode ahead; Fu Heng and the others followed; the camp was tough and the assault failed.

sentences.zh: 阿里袞疾甚，猶強起督攻，視槍砲最多處輒身當之。

translations.literal: Ali Gun was gravely ill yet forced himself up to direct the assault, always placing himself where muskets and cannon were thickest.
translations.idiomatic: Though desperately ill he rose to command, always standing where fire was heaviest.

sentences.zh: 傅恆慮其傷，令將舟師，毋更與攻寨。

translations.literal: Fu Heng, fearing for his safety, ordered him to command the fleet and not join the assault on the stockade again.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Heng, fearing for him, put him in charge of the boats and kept him off the walls.

sentences.zh: 十二月，卒於軍，諡襄壯，祀賢良祠。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he died in camp; he was given the posthumous name Xiangzhuang and enshrined in the Hall of Worthy Ministers.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the twelfth month; posthumous name Xiangzhuang; enshrined among worthy ministers.

sentences.zh: 以豐升額金川功，追加封號為果毅繼勇公。

translations.literal: Because Fengshengge had merit in Jinchuan, his enfeoffment was raised to Duke of Fruit Resolution and Continued Courage.
translations.idiomatic: Fengshengge Jinchuan service raised the house to Duke of Fruit Resolution and Continued Courage.

sentences.zh: 子豐升額、倭興額、色克精額、布彥達賚。

translations.literal: His sons were Fengshengge, Weixinge, Sekijingge, and Buyandabai.
translations.idiomatic: His sons: Fengshengge, Weixinge, Sekijingge, Buyandabai.

sentences.zh: 豐升額，自三等侍衛襲封一等公，擢領侍衛內大臣，署兵部尚書、鑲藍旗蒙古都統。

translations.literal: Fengshengge, starting from third-class bodyguard, inherited a first-class duke, was promoted to grand minister of the inner guard, and acted as War minister and Mongol lieutenant-general of the Bordered Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Fengshengge rose from third-class guard to first-class duke, inner guard grand minister, acting War minister, and Bordered Blue Mongol lieutenant-general.

sentences.zh: 三十五年八月，命在軍機處行走。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the thirty-fifth year he was ordered to serve at the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of year 35 he joined the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 金川再用兵，定邊左副將軍溫福為帥，劾參贊大臣伍岱乖謬。

translations.literal: When Jinchuan war broke out again, Pacification western left deputy Wen Fu was commander and impeached commissioner Wu Dai for misconduct.
translations.idiomatic: Jinchuan flared again; Wen Fu commanded and impeached Wu Dai.

sentences.zh: 上命豐升額往勘，因授豐升額參贊大臣。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered Fengshengge to investigate and then made him campaign commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor sent Fengshengge to investigate and made him commissioner.

sentences.zh: 五月，豐升額攻東瑪寨，偽退以致敵，令章京佛倫泰、富爾賽突起偪寨，侍衛伸達蘇發鉅砲，敵驚卻，多墜崖死，遂克東瑪。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Fengshengge attacked Dongma stockade, feigned retreat to lure the enemy, had clerks Foluntai and Fuersai rush the works, and bodyguard Shendasu fired great cannon; the enemy fled in panic, many fell from cliffs and died, and Dongma was taken.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month he feigned retreat at Dongma, rushed the stockade with Foluntai and Fuersai, blasted with Shendasu cannon, drove the foe over cliffs, and took Dongma.

sentences.zh: 六月，攻固卜濟山梁。

translations.literal: In the sixth month he attacked the Gubuji mountain ridge.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month he struck the Gubuji ridge.

sentences.zh: 師至色爾渠，令烏什哈達、巴三泰等左右進攻。

translations.literal: When the army reached Seerqu he ordered Ushihada, Basantai, and others to attack from left and right.
translations.idiomatic: At Seerqu he sent Ushihada and Basantai against both flanks.

sentences.zh: 豐升額出中路，發砲墮碉。

translations.literal: Fengshengge took the center route and fired cannon that toppled the blockhouse.
translations.idiomatic: Fengshengge took the center and knocked down the blockhouse with cannon.

sentences.zh: 烏什哈達等引兵出岩下，豐升額自山徑策應鏖戰，敵大奔。

translations.literal: Ushihada and others led troops out below the cliff; Fengshengge answered along the mountain path and fought fiercely until the enemy broke in flight.
translations.idiomatic: Ushihada came out under the cliff; Fengshengge met him on the path; the enemy ran.

sentences.zh: 七月，复克色爾渠大碉及卡房百餘。

translations.literal: In the seventh month he again took the great blockhouse at Seerqu and more than a hundred watch posts.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month he took Seerqu great blockhouse and a hundred posts.

sentences.zh: 卡房，敵所置堠也。

translations.literal: Watch posts were enemy sentry positions.
translations.idiomatic: The posts were enemy sentry lines.

sentences.zh: 旋與溫福大軍合，十月，克路頂宗、喀木色爾諸寨。

translations.literal: Soon he joined Wen Fu main force; in the tenth month they took Ludingzong, Kamuseer, and other stockades.
translations.idiomatic: He joined Wen Fu; in the tenth month Ludingzong, Kamuseer, and other camps fell.

sentences.zh: 復進克兜烏山樑及附近諸寨。

translations.literal: They advanced again and took the Douwu mountain ridge and nearby stockades.
translations.idiomatic: They took Douwu ridge and neighboring camps.

sentences.zh: 十一月，克博爾根山，奪瑪覺烏大寨。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month they took Boergen mountain and seized the Majuewu great stockade.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Boergen mountain and Majuewu great camp were taken.

sentences.zh: 再進克明郭宗，下碉卡九十餘。

translations.literal: Advancing again they took Mingguozong and more than ninety blockhouses and posts below.
translations.idiomatic: They took Mingguozong and ninety-odd posts below.

sentences.zh: 克嘉巴山，焚經樓。

translations.literal: They took Jiaba mountain and burned the scripture hall.
translations.idiomatic: They burned Jiaba scripture hall.

sentences.zh: 語詳溫福傳。

translations.literal: Details are in Wen Fu biography.
translations.idiomatic: See Wen Fu biography.

sentences.zh: 十二月，授豐升額副將軍。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Fengshengge was made deputy general.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he became deputy general.

sentences.zh: 三十八年正月，與將軍溫福、副將軍阿桂議分道並進，溫福自功噶爾拉進攻噶爾薩爾，阿桂自僧格宗經納圍納扎木，至當噶爾拉，待溫福軍至，與合攻噶拉依。

translations.literal: In the first month of the thirty-eighth year he with Wen Fu and A Gui planned a divided advance: Wen Fu from Gonggaerla toward Gaersaer, A Gui from Senggezong through Naweinazhamu to Danggaerla to meet Wen Fu and jointly attack Galayi.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 38 he, Wen Fu, and A Gui split columns toward Galayi as planned.

sentences.zh: 豐升額自章谷、吉地經綽斯甲布，溫福分遣參贊大臣舒常駐軍於此，與合攻勒烏圍。

translations.literal: Fengshengge from Zhanggu and Jidi through Chuosijia bu; Wen Fu detached commissioner Shuchang to garrison there and join the attack on Lewuwei.
translations.idiomatic: Fengshengge marched via Zhanggu and Chuosijia; Shuchang garrisoned and helped take Lewuwei.

sentences.zh: 豐升額駐軍宜喜，於其地設糧台，規進取。

translations.literal: Fengshengge garrisoned Yixi, set a grain depot, and planned the advance.
translations.idiomatic: He garrisoned Yixi, opened a grain depot, and planned forward.

sentences.zh: 四月，考績，加太子少保。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, at merit review, he was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month he received Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 溫福師銳進，六月，次木果木。

translations.literal: Wen Fu army pressed on sharply; in the sixth month it reached Muguo wood.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Fu pushed hard; in the sixth month he reached Muguo wood.

sentences.zh: 阿桂亦克當噶爾拉。

translations.literal: A Gui also took Danggaerla.
translations.idiomatic: A Gui took Danggaerla too.

sentences.zh: 上令豐升額攻大板昭，命未至，木果木師潰，溫福死之。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered Fengshengge to attack Daban Zhao, but before the order arrived the Muguo wood army collapsed and Wen Fu died.
translations.idiomatic: He was told to hit Daban Zhao; before word came Muguo wood collapsed and Wen Fu died.

sentences.zh: 上聞敗，命豐升額引兵自黨壩、三雜穀至巴朗拉為阿桂聲援。

translations.literal: On news of defeat the Emperor ordered Fengshengge from Dangba and Sanzagou to Barangla to support A Gui.
translations.idiomatic: After defeat he was sent from Dangba and Sanzagou to Barangla to aid A Gui.

sentences.zh: 既聞阿桂自當噶爾拉全師而出，屯翁古爾壟，諭豐升額仍駐宜喜為犄角。

translations.literal: Learning A Gui had brought the whole force out from Danggaerla to Wengguerlong, the court told Fengshengge to stay at Yixi as a flank guard.
translations.idiomatic: When A Gui rallied at Wengguerlong, Fengshengge was kept at Yixi as flank.

sentences.zh: 豐升額初未移軍，分兵駐智固山，防後路。

translations.literal: At first Fengshengge had not moved; he detached troops to Zhigu mountain to guard the rear.
translations.idiomatic: He had not moved yet and posted men on Zhigu mountain for the rear.

sentences.zh: 阿桂以定西將軍為帥，十一月，收小金川全境。

translations.literal: A Gui as Dingxi general took the whole Lesser Jinchuan in the eleventh month.
translations.idiomatic: A Gui as Dingxi general pacified Lesser Jinchuan in the eleventh month.

sentences.zh: 豐升額自宜喜攻克沙壩山梁碉卡，分敵勢。

translations.literal: Fengshengge from Yixi took Shabashan ridge blockhouses to divide enemy strength.
translations.idiomatic: From Yixi he took Shabashan posts to split the enemy.

sentences.zh: 十二月，阿桂定策自取谷噶，而令豐升額攻凱立葉，進兵。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month A Gui decided to take Guga himself and ordered Fengshengge to attack Kailiye and advance.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month A Gui took Guga himself and sent Fengshengge at Kailiye.

sentences.zh: 上命豐升額以五千人往攻，三十九年正月，師次薩爾赤鄂羅山，佔其南雪山，又分兵屯孟拜拉山梁。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered Fengshengge forward with five thousand; in the first month of the thirty-ninth year the army reached Saierchieoluo mountain, held the southern snow peak, and detached troops to Mengbaila ridge.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 39, with five thousand men, he held Saierchieoluo south peak and Mengbaila ridge.

sentences.zh: 阿桂遣納木扎等將二千人與合軍。

translations.literal: A Gui sent Namuzha and two thousand men to join him.
translations.idiomatic: A Gui added Namuzha with two thousand.

sentences.zh: 二月晦夜半，豐升額帥師自達爾扎克北山澖越石蹋雪以進。

translations.literal: At midnight on the last day of the second month Fengshengge led the army from Darzak north mountain, wading snow over stone.
translations.idiomatic: On the last night of the second month he crossed Darzak north slope through snow.

sentences.zh: 次日黎明，至凱立葉山麓。

translations.literal: The next day at dawn they reached the foot of Kailiye mountain.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn next day they stood at Kailiye foot.

sentences.zh: 山絕險，凡大峰各置碉，見我師至且近，槍石並發。

translations.literal: The mountain was extremely steep; each great peak had a blockhouse; when our troops drew near, muskets and stones flew together.
translations.idiomatic: Peaks were sheer, each crowned with a blockhouse; as the troops neared, shot and stone hailed down.

sentences.zh: 豐升額督師直前衝擊，與侍衛彰靄、明仁取第二峰，瑪爾佔、伊達里取第三峰，令領隊大臣五岱營第三峰下。

translations.literal: Fengshengge directed a frontal rush; with bodyguards Zhangai and Mingren he took the second peak; Marzhan and Yidali the third; he ordered column leader Wudai to camp below the third peak.
translations.idiomatic: He charged the center; Zhangai and Mingren took the second peak; Marzhan and Yidali the third; Wudai camped below.

sentences.zh: 捷聞，上以碉據峰巔，仰攻不易克，命留五岱於此，而移軍谷噶，與阿桂合軍攻勒烏圍。

translations.literal: On victory the Emperor, seeing blockhouses on peak tops hard to storm from below, ordered Wudai to remain while the army shifted to Guga to join A Gui against Lewuwei.
translations.idiomatic: Victory news came; the Emperor kept Wudai on the peak and moved the main body to Guga with A Gui.

sentences.zh: 阿桂遣諜告豐升額：「達爾扎克面當莫爾敏山，山旁地曰迪噶拉穆扎。

translations.literal: A Gui sent word: Darzak faces Mount Moermin; beside the mountain is land called Digalamuza.
translations.idiomatic: A Gui spies said Digalamuza lay beside Moermin beyond Darzak.

sentences.zh: 師得此，繞出凱立葉後，夾攻易為力。」

translations.literal: If the army holds this place and circles behind Kailiye, a pincer will be easier.
translations.idiomatic: Holding it would let the army turn Kailiye rear and pinch the foe.

sentences.zh: 豐升額即遣兵佔莫爾敏山，敵力爭，絕我師前後不相屬，卒敗敵，取迪噶拉穆扎。

translations.literal: Fengshengge at once sent troops to seize Mount Moermin; the enemy fought hard, cutting front from rear, but were defeated and Digalamuza was taken.
translations.idiomatic: He seized Moermin; the enemy severed his lines yet lost Digalamuza.

sentences.zh: 豐升額尋從上命移軍谷噶。

translations.literal: Fengshengge soon moved to Guga on imperial order.
translations.idiomatic: He soon shifted to Guga as ordered.

sentences.zh: 六月，克色繃普，破碉十一。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Sebengpu was taken and eleven blockhouses broken.
