translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Sebengpu fell and eleven blockhouses went.

sentences.zh: 七月，克該布達什諾大碉。

translations.literal: In the seventh month the great blockhouse at Gaibudashinuo was taken.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Gaibudashinuo great blockhouse fell.

sentences.zh: 十月，自間道克墨格爾陟曰爾巴當噶西峰，破碉寨二百餘，得凱立葉山梁之半。

translations.literal: In the tenth month by a side path he took the west peak of Mogeer Chenri Badangga and broke more than two hundred blockhouses and stockades, gaining half the Kailiye ridge.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month a side path took Mogeer west peak and two hundred works—half of Kailiye ridge.

sentences.zh: 命議敘，賚玄狐帽、貂馬褂。

translations.literal: Merit was debated; he was given a sable hat and sable jacket.
translations.idiomatic: Merit was recorded; he received sable hat and jacket.

sentences.zh: 十一月，攻格魯古丫口，通黨壩，遂進逼勒烏圍。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month he attacked Geluguyakou, opened the route to Dangba, and pressed Lewuwei.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Geluguyakou fell, Dangba opened, and Lewuwei was pressed.

sentences.zh: 四十年正月，克甲爾納堪布卓沿河諸碉寨。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fortieth year he took the blockhouses and stockades along the Jiaernazangbu river.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 40 he cleared Jiaernazangbu posts.

sentences.zh: 四月，破噶爾丹寺及噶朗噶木柵十七。

translations.literal: In the fourth month he broke Gaerdan monastery and seventeen Galangamu palisades.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Gaerdan monastery and seventeen palisades fell.

sentences.zh: 五月，克丫口石碉八、木城四。

translations.literal: In the fifth month he took eight stone blockhouses and four timber forts at the pass.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month eight stone forts and four timber forts at the pass fell.

sentences.zh: 再進，盡隳遜克爾宗諸碉寨。

translations.literal: Advancing again he destroyed all Xunkeerzong blockhouses and stockades.
translations.idiomatic: He advanced and razed Xunkeerzong works.

sentences.zh: 敕獎其奮勉，命封號加「繼勇」字。

translations.literal: An edict praised his zeal and added Continued Courage to his title.
translations.idiomatic: The throne praised his drive and added Continued Courage to his rank.

sentences.zh: 七月，師至章噶，碉甚堅，碉外為壕三重，壕外立木柵。

translations.literal: In the seventh month the army reached Zhangga; the blockhouse was very strong, with three moats outside and a timber palisade beyond the moats.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month at Zhangga a triple-moated blockhouse stood behind a timber wall.

sentences.zh: 海蘭察攻其中，豐升額督官達色、仁和等攻其左右，毀柵覆壕以度師，緣碉側直上，自其巔俯攻，遂克之，並得其旁木城。

translations.literal: Hailancha attacked the center; Fengshengge directed Guandase, Renhe, and others on the flanks, destroyed the palisade and filled the moats for the troops to cross, climbed the blockhouse side straight up, and attacked from the summit; it fell and the adjoining timber fort was taken.
translations.idiomatic: Hailancha hit the center; Fengshengge flanked with Guandase and Renhe, tore the palisade, filled moats, climbed the wall crown, and took the timber fort beside it.

sentences.zh: 八月，與阿桂合克勒烏圍。

translations.literal: In the eighth month he joined A Gui to take Lewuwei.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month he and A Gui took Lewuwei.

sentences.zh: 九月，復進向噶拉依。

translations.literal: In the ninth month he advanced again toward Galayi.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month he pushed on Galayi.

sentences.zh: 十二月，克格隆古科布曲山梁。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Gelonggu Kebuqu ridge was taken.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Gelonggu Kebuqu ridge fell.

sentences.zh: 四十一年正月，克瑪爾古當噶山梁。

translations.literal: In the first month of the forty-first year Margudangga ridge was taken.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 41 Margudangga ridge fell.

sentences.zh: 金川全部悉定。

translations.literal: All of Jinchuan was now settled.
translations.idiomatic: All Jinchuan was pacified.

sentences.zh: 師圍噶拉依，上命加豐升額一等子，以其弟布彥達賚襲爵。

translations.literal: While the army besieged Galayi the Emperor raised Fengshengge by one step to first-class viscount and had his brother Buyandabai inherit the title.
translations.idiomatic: During the Galayi siege he was raised one step to first-class viscount; Buyandabai inherited the dukedom.

sentences.zh: 尋移戶部尚書，賜雙眼孔雀翎。

translations.literal: He was soon made Revenue minister and given a double-eyed peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: He soon became Revenue minister with a double-eyed peacock plume.

sentences.zh: 二月，金川酋索諾木出降，致京師。

translations.literal: In the second month Jinchuan chief Suonuomu surrendered and was sent to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month chief Suonuomu surrendered and went to court.

sentences.zh: 四月，師還，賚禦廝馬俱鞍轡，圖形紫光閣。

translations.literal: In the fourth month the army returned; he was given imperial horses with full harness and his portrait placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month the army came home; he received imperial horses and a Purple Splendor portrait.

sentences.zh: 四十二年十月，卒，贈太子太保，諡誠武。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the forty-second year he died; he was posthumously made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent with the name Chengwu.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of year 42 he died; posthumous Grand Guardian Chengwu.

sentences.zh: 布彥達賚，自三等侍衛累遷武備院卿。

translations.literal: Buyandabai, from third-class bodyguard, rose to director of the Armory.
translations.idiomatic: Buyandabai rose from third-class guard to Armory director.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶間，授戶部尚書、正白旗滿洲都統、步軍左翼總兵署統領。

translations.literal: In the Jiaqing era he was made Revenue minister, Plain White Manchu lieutenant-general, and acting commander of the Left Vanguard Brigade.
translations.idiomatic: Under Jiaqing he became Revenue minister, Plain White lieutenant-general, and Left Vanguard acting commander.

sentences.zh: 五年，卒，贈太子太保，諡恭勤。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he died; he was posthumously made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent with the name Gongqin.
translations.idiomatic: In year 5 he died; posthumous Grand Guardian Gongqin.

sentences.zh: 布彥達賚女為宣宗元妃，道光元年，冊諡孝穆皇后，禮成，追封三等公。

translations.literal: Buyandabai daughter was the Xuanzong primary consort; in the first year of Daoguang she was enfeoffed as Empress Xiaomu; after the rites were complete the house was raised to third-class duke.
translations.idiomatic: His daughter became Xuanzong consort and, as Empress Xiaomu in Daoguang 1, raised the clan to third-class duke.

sentences.zh: 舒赫德，字伯容，舒穆魯氏，滿洲正白旗人，徐元夢孫也。

translations.literal: Shuhede, style name Borong, of the Shumulu clan, was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner and grandson of Xu Yuanmeng.
translations.idiomatic: Shuhede, styled Borong, Shumulu clan, Plain White Banner, was Xu Yuanmeng grandson.

sentences.zh: 舒赫德，自筆帖式授內閣中書，累遷御史，充軍機處章京。

translations.literal: Shuhede rose from bitishi to Grand Secretariat secretary, then censor, and served as a Grand Council clerk.
translations.idiomatic: He rose from bitishi to secretariat secretary, censor, and Grand Council clerk.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二年，疏言：「八旗生齒日繁。

translations.literal: In the second year of Qianlong he memorialized: The Eight Banners population grows daily.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 2 he wrote: Eight Banner numbers grow daily.

sentences.zh: 盛京、黑龍江、寧古塔三省土沃可耕。

translations.literal: Fengtian, Heilongjiang, and Ningguta three provinces have fertile land fit for farming.
translations.idiomatic: Fengtian, Heilongjiang, and Ningguta have arable soil.

sentences.zh: 請將閒散移屯。

translations.literal: He asked to move idle bannermen to frontier farms.
translations.idiomatic: He asked to move idle bannermen to frontier farms.

sentences.zh: 併條議設公庫，以各省稅務專屬旗員，贖旗地典於民者，以官地畀無地旗丁。

translations.literal: He also proposed setting public treasuries, putting provincial tax offices solely in banner hands, redeeming banner land pawned to commoners and giving official land to landless bannermen.
translations.idiomatic: He also urged public treasuries, banner-only tax posts, redeeming pawned banner land, and giving official plots to landless bannermen.

sentences.zh: 以十年為期，次第施行。」

translations.literal: Over ten years these measures were to be carried out step by step.
translations.idiomatic: The plan was to phase it in over ten years.

sentences.zh: 上以稅務專屬旗員為非是，諭曰：「舒赫德此議，但知旗人生計艱難，不知國家設關，欲稽察姦宄，非為收稅之員身家計也。

translations.literal: The Emperor rejected putting tax offices solely in banner hands and said: Shuhede proposal knows only the hardship of banner livelihood and not that customs posts exist to check smuggling and fraud, not to enrich tax clerks.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor rejected banner-only taxes, saying Shuhede saw banner poverty but not that customs exist to stop smuggling, not to enrich clerks.

sentences.zh: 朕日以砥礪廉隅勉臣工，尚恐其不能遵奉，而可以謀利導之乎？

translations.literal: I daily urge integrity on my ministers and still fear they will not obey—how can I guide them toward profit?
translations.idiomatic: I daily preach integrity and still fear disobedience—how guide them to profit?

sentences.zh: 況各省稅務本未分滿、漢，旗員有廉潔者，何嘗不可派委。

translations.literal: Moreover provincial taxes were never divided between Manchu and Han; honest bannermen have often been appointed.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial taxes were never Manchu-Han split; honest bannermen were often appointed.

sentences.zh: 大抵為上者施逮下之仁，惟有勵以忠勤，示以節儉；

translations.literal: In general a ruler bestows kindness on subjects by urging loyalty and diligence and showing frugality;
translations.idiomatic: A ruler aids subjects by urging loyalty, diligence, and frugality;

sentences.zh: 為下者皆當早作夜思，宣力供職，以永受國家惠養。

translations.literal: subjects should rise early and sleep late, exert themselves in office, and forever enjoy the state nourishing grace.
translations.idiomatic: subjects should toil early and late in service and enjoy state nurture forever.

sentences.zh: 方可謂之計長久。

translations.literal: Only then may one speak of long-term planning.
translations.idiomatic: Only that is long-term planning.

sentences.zh: 蓋厚其生計，不可不思，而長貪以為惠下，則未見其利，而且貽害，非所以教旗員，亦非所以愛旗員也。」

translations.literal: To thicken livelihood is right to consider, but to encourage greed as kindness harms without benefit and is no way to teach or love bannermen.
translations.idiomatic: Thickening livelihood is wise; encouraging greed as favor harms bannermen instead of teaching them.

sentences.zh: 初，雍正間，京師設官米局，收旗丁餉米存儲平糶。

translations.literal: Earlier in the Yongzheng era Beijing had set a government rice office to store banner pay rice for fair sale.
translations.idiomatic: Under Yongzheng Beijing had a government rice office for banner pay rice.

sentences.zh: 舒赫德疏請復設，從之。

translations.literal: Shuhede memorialized to restore it and the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Shuhede asked to restore it and the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 五遷至兵部尚書，移戶部尚書。

translations.literal: Through five promotions he reached minister of War and was moved to minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In five steps he reached War minister, then Revenue.

sentences.zh: 十三年，命從經略大學士傅恆徵金川，授參贊，加太子太保。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was ordered to follow campaign commander Grand Secretary Fu Heng against Jinchuan, was made commissioner, and given Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In year 13 he followed Fu Heng against Jinchuan as commissioner with Grand Guardian rank.

sentences.zh: 十四年，師還，留辦軍需奏銷。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, when the army returned, he stayed to handle military supplies and accounts.
translations.idiomatic: In year 14 he stayed behind to settle military accounts.

sentences.zh: 命往雲南、湖廣、河南查閱營伍，並勘雲南金沙江運銅水道。

translations.literal: He was ordered to inspect garrisons in Yunnan, Huguang, and Henan and survey the Yunnan Jinsha River copper transport route.
translations.idiomatic: He inspected troops in Yunnan, Huguang, and Henan and surveyed Jinsha copper routes.

sentences.zh: 舒赫德疏言金沙江下游銅運無阻，上游四十餘灘多峻險，仍當陸運。

translations.literal: Shuhede memorialized that downstream Jinsha copper transport was unimpeded but more than forty rapids upstream were steep and dangerous and overland haul should continue.
translations.idiomatic: Shuhede said downstream copper moved freely but forty upstream rapids still required land haul.

sentences.zh: 總督張允隨言上下游皆疏通，語不實。

translations.literal: Governor Zhang Yunsui said both reaches were cleared—untrue.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Zhang Yunsui claimed both reaches open—false.

sentences.zh: 古州總兵哈尚德因古州被水，請移城，上令舒赫德相度。

translations.literal: Guyizhou commandant Ha Shangde, because Guyizhou was flooded, asked to move the city; the Emperor ordered Shuhede to survey.
translations.idiomatic: Guyizhou commandant Ha Shangde sought to move the city after floods; Shuhede was sent to survey.

sentences.zh: 舒赫德請城內外疏積水，無待移建。

translations.literal: Shuhede asked to drain accumulated water inside and outside the walls without rebuilding elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: Shuhede urged draining the city instead of relocating.

sentences.zh: 十月，复移兵部尚書。

translations.literal: In the tenth month he was again made minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month he returned to War minister.

sentences.zh: 十五年，疏言：「定例額兵百人缺二，謂之'名糧'，為軍中公使錢。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he memorialized: By regulation a quota of a hundred troops may lack two men, called name-ration pay, for army public expenses.
translations.idiomatic: In year 15 he wrote: Regulations allow two vacancies per hundred troops as name-ration funds for public army costs.

sentences.zh: 惟繕治軍器、巡防路費，每不給於用。

translations.literal: Yet repairing weapons and patrol expenses often fell short.
translations.idiomatic: Weapon repair and patrol costs often ran short.

sentences.zh: 馬兵不宜於東南，其在西北，十居其八，亦可量減。

translations.literal: Cavalry are unsuited to the southeast; in the northwest they make eight tenths and may be reduced somewhat.
translations.idiomatic: Cavalry suit the northwest, not the southeast, and could be trimmed.

sentences.zh: 藤牌兵全無實用。

translations.literal: Rattan-shield troops are wholly useless.
translations.idiomatic: Rattan-shield troops were useless.

sentences.zh: 擬於馬兵、藤牌兵內加增名糧，以備公用。」

translations.literal: He proposed increasing name-ration pay within cavalry and rattan-shield units for public use.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed raising name-ration pay in cavalry and rattan units.

sentences.zh: 廷議允行。

translations.literal: Court debate approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 十二月，命如浙江勘海塘。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he was ordered to Jiangsu to survey the sea wall.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he surveyed the Jiangsu sea wall.

sentences.zh: 十六年，命勘永定河工。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he was ordered to inspect Yongding River works.
translations.idiomatic: In year 16 he inspected Yongding River works.

sentences.zh: 又命如浙江按杭州將軍覺羅額爾登受賕狀。

translations.literal: He was also ordered to Zhejiang to investigate whether Hangzhou general Jioro Erden had taken bribes.
translations.idiomatic: He also went to Zhejiang on bribery charges against Hangzhou general Erden.

sentences.zh: 十七年，命偕侍郎玉保赴北路軍防準噶爾。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he was ordered with Vice Minister Yubao to the northern route to guard against the Dzungars.
translations.idiomatic: In year 17 he and Vice Minister Yubao guarded the northern route against Dzungars.

sentences.zh: 十八年，以準噶爾內亂，撤防，召還。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, with Dzungar internal disorder, defenses were withdrawn and he was recalled.
translations.idiomatic: In year 18 Dzungar unrest led to withdrawal and recall.

sentences.zh: 命如江南塞銅山張家馬路河決。

translations.literal: He was ordered to Jiangnan to block the Zhangjia Malu breach on Tongshan.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent to seal the Zhangjia Malu breach on Tongshan.

sentences.zh: 時準噶爾達瓦齊復為台吉，所部杜爾伯特台吉車凌等來降。

translations.literal: At that time Dzungar Dawachi again became taiji and his tribesman Torghut taiji Cheleng and others came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Dawachi regained power; Torghut taiji Cheleng and others submitted.

sentences.zh: 準噶爾宰桑瑪木特，烏梁海得木齊扎木參、瑚圖克等追車凌，先後闌入北路卡倫。

translations.literal: Dzungar zaisang Mamute and Wusunhai Demuqi Zhamcan, Hutuke, and others chased Cheleng and successively crossed northern frontier passes.
translations.idiomatic: Zaisang Mamute and Wusunhai Demuqi Zhamcan and Hutuke chased Cheleng across the passes.

sentences.zh: 上命舒赫德如鄂爾坤治軍事，而令侍郎玉保、前鋒統領努三、散秩大臣薩喇爾佐定邊左副將軍成袞扎布。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered Shuhede to Erkun for military affairs and Vice Minister Yubao, vanguard commander Nusan, and minister Saral to assist western left deputy Chengun Zhabu.
translations.idiomatic: Shuhede went to Erkun; Yubao, Nusan, and Saral aided Chengun Zhabu.

sentences.zh: 十九年春，舒赫德至軍，參贊大臣達清阿誘致瑪木特，將檻送京師，疏聞，上以瑪木特聞召即至，命釋使還。

translations.literal: In the spring of the nineteenth year Shuhede reached the army; commissioner Daqinga induced Mamute to come and planned to send him to the capital in a cage cart; when reported, the Emperor, seeing Mamute came on summons, ordered him released and sent back.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year 19 Daqinga lured Mamute in; the court first ordered a cage cart, then released him when he came willingly.

sentences.zh: 既，薩喇爾、努三帥師出邊，獲扎木參、瑚圖克，舒赫德等復疏請檻送京師。

translations.literal: Later Saral and Nusan led troops beyond the border and captured Zhamcan and Hutuke; Shuhede and others again asked to send them to the capital in cage carts.
translations.idiomatic: Later Saral and Nusan took Zhamcan and Hutuke; Shuhede again asked for cage carts.

sentences.zh: 上以瑪木特誘致，扎木參等乃逐捕所得，事不同，責舒赫德謬誤，命以扎木參等囚置軍中。

translations.literal: The Emperor said Mamute had been induced while Zhamcan and others were taken in pursuit—the cases differed—and rebuked Shuhede for error, ordering Zhamcan and others held prisoner in the army.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said Mamute was lured but Zhamcan was captured in chase, rebuked Shuhede, and kept the prisoners in camp.

sentences.zh: 軍中方傳達瓦齊遣其將扎努噶爾布以五千人犯邊。

translations.literal: In camp it was rumored Dawachi had sent Zanagarbu with five thousand men to raid the border.
translations.idiomatic: Rumor said Dawachi sent Zanagarbu with five thousand to raid.

sentences.zh: 成袞扎布等致書達瓦齊，言瑪木特、扎木參等以入邊被捕本末。

translations.literal: Chengun Zhabu and others wrote Dawachi explaining how Mamute and Zhamcan had entered the border and been seized.
translations.idiomatic: Chengun Zhabu wrote Dawachi explaining the border arrests.

sentences.zh: 上以為太懦，諭舒赫德等。

translations.literal: The Emperor called this too timid and instructed Shuhede and the rest.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor called it timid and lectured Shuhede.

sentences.zh: 上方以準噶爾內訌，將乘時收烏梁海，以薩喇爾本蒙古頭人，習邊事，將倚以招致。

translations.literal: The Emperor wished to take advantage of Dzungar strife to recover Wusunhai and meant to rely on Saral, a Mongol chief who knew frontier affairs, to win them over.
translations.idiomatic: The court meant to recover Wusunhai and rely on Mongol chief Saral to win tribes.

sentences.zh: 舒赫德等疏言達瓦齊復為台吉，烏梁海等未易招致，令薩喇爾駐軍卓克索待後舉。

translations.literal: Shuhede and others memorialized that with Dawachi again taiji Wusunhai would be hard to win and ordered Saral to camp at Zhuokesuo and wait.
translations.idiomatic: Shuhede said Dawachi revival made Wusunhai hard to win and told Saral to wait at Zhuokesuo.

sentences.zh: 上責舒赫德畏怯，使薩喇爾掣肘。

translations.literal: The Emperor rebuked Shuhede for cowardice that hamstrung Saral.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor scolded Shuhede for cowardice that tied Saral hands.

sentences.zh: 蒙古貝勒額琳沁、公格勒克巴木丕勒以赴軍遷延得罪，舒赫德等疏言其至軍後奮勉，請贖罪。

translations.literal: Mongol princes Elinqin and Gonggeleke Bambile were punished for delaying on the march; Shuhede and others memorialized that after reaching the army they strove hard and asked to redeem guilt.
translations.idiomatic: Princes Elinqin and Gonggeleke Bambile were punished for delay; Shuhede asked mercy for zeal at the front.

sentences.zh: 上下詔責其舛謬，並及行文達瓦齊事，下部議奪官，得旨寬免。

translations.literal: The throne issued a rebuking edict for their errors, including the letter to Dawachi; the ministry recommended stripping rank but mercy was granted.
translations.idiomatic: An edict rebuked them; stripping rank was recommended but waived.

sentences.zh: 上幸熱河，召舒赫德詣行在示方略。

translations.literal: The Emperor was at Rehe and summoned Shuhede to the traveling palace to show strategy.
translations.idiomatic: At Rehe the Emperor summoned Shuhede for strategy.

sentences.zh: 旋解成袞扎布將軍以授策楞。

translations.literal: He soon relieved Chengun Zhabu of the generalship and gave it to Celeng.
translations.idiomatic: He soon replaced Chengun Zhabu with Celeng as general.

sentences.zh: 七月，輝特台吉阿睦爾撒納來降。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Choros taiji Amursana came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Amursana submitted.

sentences.zh: 舒赫德與策楞議留阿睦爾撒納及諸頭人軍中待命，以其孥移置蘇尼特。

translations.literal: Shuhede and Celeng planned to keep Amursana and the chiefs in camp awaiting orders and move their families to Sunite.
translations.idiomatic: Shuhede and Celeng kept Amursana in camp and moved his kin to Sunite.

sentences.zh: 阿睦爾撒納有兄為瑪木特所獲，乞資以行糧俾赴援，舒赫德不許。

translations.literal: Amursana had a brother taken by Mamute and begged travel grain to rescue him; Shuhede refused.
translations.idiomatic: Amursana brother was Mamute prisoner; he begged grain to rescue; Shuhede refused.

sentences.zh: 是時上方欲倚阿睦爾撒納擒達瓦齊，事聞，上盛怒，詔罪狀策楞、舒赫德，略謂：「阿睦爾撒納初來降，乃以其眷屬移置戈壁南，相距數千里，使其父母妻子分析離居，失遠人歸附心。

translations.literal: The Emperor then wished to rely on Amursana to seize Dawachi; when word came he was furious and indicted Celeng and Shuhede, saying in part: When Amursana first submitted you moved his kin thousands of li south into the Gobi, separating parents, wives, and children and losing the hearts of distant peoples.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor wanted Amursana to catch Dawachi; he raged at moving Amursana kin far south and breaking their hearts.

sentences.zh: 準噶爾內亂，所部叩關內附，正可示以懷柔，永綏邊境。

translations.literal: With Dzungar internal disorder tribes knocking at the passes to submit, kindness could have secured the frontier forever.
translations.idiomatic: Dzungar strife offered a chance to win tribes by kindness forever.

sentences.zh: 策楞、舒赫德顛倒舛謬，至於此極！」

translations.literal: Celeng and Shuhede reversed all priorities to this extreme!
translations.idiomatic: Celeng and Shuhede got everything backwards!

sentences.zh: 皆奪職，以閒散在參贊大臣上效力贖罪，並籍其家，罪及諸子。

translations.literal: Both were stripped of office, ordered to serve as idle men above commissioners to redeem guilt, and their property and sons were punished.
translations.idiomatic: Both lost office, served as penitents, and their property and sons suffered.

sentences.zh: 二十年正月，上命阿睦爾撒納佐班第帥師討達瓦齊。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twentieth year the Emperor ordered Amursana to assist Bandi in attacking Dawachi.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 20 Amursana was told to aid Bandi against Dawachi.

sentences.zh: 阿睦爾撒納請移游牧於烏里雅蘇台，上許之。

translations.literal: Amursana asked to move his herds to Uliassutai and was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Amursana moved herds to Uliassutai with permission.

sentences.zh: 命領隊大臣兆惠駐軍於此，予舒赫德章京銜佐兆惠。

translations.literal: Column leader Zhaohui was ordered to garrison there; Shuhede was given clerk rank to assist Zhaohui.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaohui garrisoned there; Shuhede assisted as clerk.

sentences.zh: 六月，師已定伊犁，諭曰：「策楞、舒赫德軍前效力，今大功已成，本欲施恩，開其自效。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, after Ili was taken, an edict said: Celeng and Shuhede served at the front; now the great work is done and mercy was intended.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, after Ili fell, an edict noted their front service.

sentences.zh: 策楞已予都統銜，駐軍巴里坤。

translations.literal: Celeng had already been given commandant rank and garrisoned Barkul.
translations.idiomatic: Celeng already held commandant rank at Barkul.

sentences.zh: 檢舒赫德筆札，雖無怨望語，乃效漢人習，日必記事作詩。

translations.literal: Examining Shuhede letters, though without complaint, he imitated Han habit, daily keeping journals and writing poetry.
translations.idiomatic: Shuhede letters showed no complaint but Han-style diaries and poetry.

sentences.zh: 嗣宜痛自改悔，令仍以章京留烏里雅蘇台。」

translations.literal: Henceforth he must repent deeply and remain a clerk at Uliassutai.
translations.idiomatic: He was told to repent and stay a clerk at Uliassutai.

sentences.zh: 上分準噶爾故地，本眾建諸侯意，四衛拉特各為汗。

translations.literal: The Emperor divided old Dzungar lands on the model of enfeoffing feudal lords; the Four Oirats each received a khan.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor split Dzungar lands among Four Oirat khans.

sentences.zh: 阿睦爾撒納求為總統，上不許，遂叛。

translations.literal: Amursana asked to be overall chief and was refused, then rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: Amursana sought overall rule, was refused, and rebelled.

sentences.zh: 其妻子在烏里雅蘇台，舒赫德偕兆惠收送京師。

translations.literal: His wife and children were at Uliassutai; Shuhede with Zhaohui sent them to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: His family at Uliassutai was sent to court by Shuhede and Zhaohui.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，喀爾喀台吉青滾雜卜叛，驛道中梗。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year Khalkha taiji Qinggun Zhabu rebelled and courier routes were cut.
translations.idiomatic: In year 21 Qinggun Zhabu rebelled and posts were cut.

sentences.zh: 會察哈爾兵數百送羊至，舒赫德留之，分佈諸台站，軍報乃通。

translations.literal: Chahar troops delivering sheep arrived; Shuhede kept them and spread them among relay stations so military reports got through.
translations.idiomatic: Chahar sheep convoys arrived; Shuhede posted them along relays and restored reports.

sentences.zh: 行邊至努兌木倫，護厄魯特人。

translations.literal: Patrolling the frontier to Nuoduimulun he protected Eleuth people.
translations.idiomatic: On the Nuoduimulun line he protected Eleuth subjects.

sentences.zh: 掠馬者烏梁海人入邊，竄匿俄羅斯，馳檄往索。

translations.literal: Horse thieves from Wusunhai entered the border and hid in Russia; he sent urgent dispatches to demand them.
translations.idiomatic: Wusunhai horse thieves fled to Russia; he demanded them back.

sentences.zh: 上嘉其治事尚協機宜，召還，授正黃旗漢軍副都統。

translations.literal: The Emperor praised his handling as generally fitting circumstances, recalled him, and made him Chinese deputy lieutenant-general of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor praised his sense of occasion, recalled him, and made him Plain Yellow Chinese deputy lieutenant-general.

sentences.zh: 二十二年正月，上命成袞扎佈為定邊將軍，逐捕阿睦爾撒納，授舒赫德參贊大臣。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twenty-second year the Emperor made Chengun Zhabu Pacification general to pursue Amursana and made Shuhede campaign commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 22 Chengun Zhabu pursued Amursana; Shuhede became commissioner.

sentences.zh: 尋擢兵部尚書，兼鑲黃旗漢軍都統。

translations.literal: He was soon promoted to War minister and also lieutenant-general of the Bordered Yellow Chinese Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He soon became War minister and Bordered Yellow Chinese lieutenant-general.

sentences.zh: 三月，以舒赫德在軍獨具疏奏事，責其放縱，罷尚書。

translations.literal: In the third month, because Shuhede alone memorialized from the army, he was rebuked for presumption and removed from the ministry.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month solo memorials from camp cost him the ministry.

sentences.zh: 七月，疏請防範沙喇斯游牧內移，上斥其藉作歸計，嚴諭申戒。

translations.literal: In the seventh month he memorialized to guard against Sharas nomads moving inward; the Emperor denounced this as a plea to withdraw and sternly warned him.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month a memorial on Sharas nomads was read as wanting to quit; he was warned sharply.

sentences.zh: 十二月，上以成袞扎布師久無功，詔罪狀舒赫德，略言：「舒赫德起自廢籍，初赴軍授方略，令傳諭成袞扎布，並戒其毋更恇怯。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, because Chengun Zhabu army had long been without success, an edict indicted Shuhede, saying in part: Shuhede rose from disgrace; at first he was sent to the army with strategy and told to instruct Chengun Zhabu and warn him against timidity again.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month an edict blamed Shuhede for Chengun Zhabu failures despite early instructions.

sentences.zh: 乃至軍後，諸事皆失機宜。

translations.literal: Yet after reaching the army he lost every opportunity.
translations.idiomatic: At the front he missed every chance.

sentences.zh: 即如招服克哷特、烏魯特等游牧，當收其馬以佐軍；

translations.literal: Even in winning over Kepite, Ulute, and other nomads he should have taken their horses for the army;
translations.idiomatic: Winning Kepite and Ulute nomads he should have taken their horses;

sentences.zh: 乃任令屯駐山中，致兵過复叛。

translations.literal: instead he let them pasture in the mountains so troops passed and they rebelled again.
translations.idiomatic: instead he let them stay in hills and they rebelled after troops passed.

sentences.zh: 及朕有旨詰責，始東遮西露，往來道途，疲馬力於無用之地。

translations.literal: Only when the throne rebuked him did he dodge and weave, wearing out horses on useless roads.
translations.idiomatic: Only after imperial rebuke did he dodge about, wasting horses on useless marches.

sentences.zh: 舉此一端，可見諸事皆無成算。

translations.literal: This one instance shows he had no plan for anything.
translations.idiomatic: That alone showed he planned nothing.

sentences.zh: 此實舒赫德未將朕旨宣示成袞扎布之所致也。

translations.literal: This truly came of Shuhede failing to convey the imperial will to Chengun Zhabu.
translations.idiomatic: It came of not passing the imperial will to Chengun Zhabu.

sentences.zh: 舒赫德罪不勝誅，朕念成袞扎布去年擒青滾雜卜之功，貰舒赫德以不死。

translations.literal: Shuhede guilt deserved death; remembering Chengun Zhabu merit last year in taking Qinggun Zhabu, the Emperor spared Shuhede.
translations.idiomatic: He deserved death; Chengun Zhabu merit spared him.

sentences.zh: 今奪職為兵，從軍贖罪。」

translations.literal: Now he was stripped to common soldier rank to redeem guilt in the army."
translations.idiomatic: He was cut to soldier rank to redeem guilt in camp."

sentences.zh: 二十三年，予頭等侍衛銜，駐阿克蘇。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year he was given first-class bodyguard rank and garrisoned Aksu.
translations.idiomatic: In year 23 he received first-class bodyguard rank and garrisoned Aksu.

sentences.zh: 十月，將軍兆惠逐捕霍集占，深入被圍。

translations.literal: In the tenth month General Zhaohui pursued Khoja Jihan deep and was surrounded.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Zhaohui pursued Khoja Jihan deep and was trapped.

sentences.zh: 命定邊右副將軍富德往援，授舒赫德參贊大臣，會於巴爾楚克。

translations.literal: Western right deputy Fude was ordered to relieve him; Shuhede was made commissioner and met at Barchuq.
translations.idiomatic: Fude was sent to relieve him; Shuhede met him at Barchuq.

sentences.zh: 舒赫德以阿克蘇通葉爾羌、喀什噶爾要隘，當設卡倫。

translations.literal: Shuhede said Aksu was the vital pass to Yarkand and Kashgar and should have checkpoints.
translations.idiomatic: Shuhede said Aksu guarded the Yarkand and Kashgar road and needed posts.

sentences.zh: 上嘉之，擢吏部侍郎，遷工部尚書、鑲紅旗滿洲都統，賜孔雀翎。

translations.literal: The Emperor praised this, raised him to Personnel vice minister, then Works minister and Bordered Red Manchu lieutenant-general, and gave a peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor praised him, made him Personnel vice minister, then Works minister with a peacock plume.

sentences.zh: 十二月，簡阿克蘇銳卒、諸路兵先至者馳援兆惠。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he picked Aksu elite troops and all early arrivals to hurry to Zhaohui.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he rushed Aksu elites to Zhaohui.

sentences.zh: 二十四年正月，與富德合軍解兆惠圍，予雲騎尉世職。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twenty-fourth year he joined Fude to break the siege and was given a hereditary Cloud Cavalry Captaincy.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 24 he and Fude broke the siege and won a hereditary Cloud Cavalry Captaincy.

sentences.zh: 七月，命移駐葉爾羌，旋命仍駐阿克蘇。

translations.literal: In the seventh month he was ordered to move garrison to Yarkand, then told to remain at Aksu.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month he was shifted to Yarkand, then kept at Aksu.

sentences.zh: 先後奏定回城賦稅，台站酌設伯克，阿克蘇鑄騰格，以四存公，六畀回人。

translations.literal: He memorialized fixing Muslim city tribute, setting relay begs, and casting tanga at Aksu with four parts for the public treasury and six for the people.
translations.idiomatic: He fixed Muslim tribute, relay begs, and Aksu coin with four parts public and six for locals.

sentences.zh: 阿克蘇、庫車、哈喇沙爾、烏什、和闐置文武吏。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials were posted at Aksu, Kucha, Karashar, Ush, and Khotan.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officers were placed at Aksu, Kucha, Karashar, Ush, and Khotan.

sentences.zh: 皆得旨議行。

translations.literal: All received imperial approval to be carried out.
translations.idiomatic: All were approved by edict.

sentences.zh: 尋以回部平，圖形紫光閣。

translations.literal: Soon, with the Muslim west pacified, his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor.
translations.idiomatic: When the Muslim west was pacified his portrait joined Purple Splendor.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，加太子太保。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year he was made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In year 28 he became Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，命如福建按提督黃仕簡劾廈門洋行陋規，總督楊廷璋以下皆得罪，語詳廷璋傳。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year he was sent to Fujian to investigate Naval Commander Huang Shijian impeachment of Xiamen foreign-trade abuses; Governor Yang Tingzhang and others were punished—as told in Tingzhang biography.
translations.idiomatic: In year 29 he investigated Xiamen trade abuses; Yang Tingzhang and others fell.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，署陝甘總督，旋署戶部尚書。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year he acted as Shaan-Gan governor-general, then acting Revenue minister.
translations.idiomatic: In year 31 he acted as Shaan-Gan governor-general, then Revenue minister.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，如湖南北讞獄。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year he tried cases in Hunan and Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: In year 32 he tried Hunan and Hubei cases.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，將軍明瑞徵緬甸，敗績，死之。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year General Ming Rui campaigned in Burma and was defeated and killed.
translations.idiomatic: In year 33 Ming Rui campaigned in Burma and died in defeat.

sentences.zh: 上命大學士傅恆為經略，授舒赫德參贊大臣，先赴雲南籌畫進軍。

translations.literal: The Emperor made Grand Secretary Fu Heng campaign commander and Shuhede commissioner, sent first to Yunnan to plan the advance.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Heng took command; Shuhede went first to Yunnan to plan.

sentences.zh: 舒赫德密疏議巡，忤上旨。

translations.literal: Shuhede secretly memorialized for peace, against the imperial will.
translations.idiomatic: Shuhede secretly urged peace against the throne.

sentences.zh: 下部議奪官，並削雲騎尉世職，命以都統銜參贊大臣，出駐烏什。

translations.literal: The ministry recommended stripping rank and the hereditary Cloud Cavalry Captaincy; he was ordered to serve as commandant-rank commissioner garrisoning Ush.
translations.idiomatic: Stripping rank was recommended; he served as commandant commissioner at Ush.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，土爾扈特汗渥巴錫等自俄羅斯來歸，眾疑其偽降，舒赫德力白無他志，命如伊犁宣撫，尋授伊犁將軍。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year Torghut khan Ubashi and others returned from Russia; many doubted a false surrender; Shuhede insisted they had no other intent and was ordered to pacify them at Ili, soon made Ili general.
translations.idiomatic: In year 36 Ubashi returned from Russia; Shuhede vouched for him and pacified Ili as general.

sentences.zh: 十一月，授戶部尚書。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month he was made Revenue minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he became Revenue minister.

sentences.zh: 三十八年，加太子太保，授武英殿大學士。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year he was made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and Grand Secretary of the Hall of Military Glory.
translations.idiomatic: In year 38 he became Grand Guardian and Military Glory grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 九月，命如江南監黃河老壩口堤工。

translations.literal: In the ninth month he was ordered to Jiangnan to supervise the Laobaokou Yellow River dike.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month he supervised Laobaokou Yellow River dikes in Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 壽張民王倫叛，破臨清，命督師進剿，克之，倫自燔死。

translations.literal: Shouzhang commoner Wang Lun rebelled, took Linqing; Shuhede was ordered to command the suppression, took the city, and Lun burned himself to death.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Lun rebelled at Shouzhang and took Linqing; Shuhede crushed him and Lun burned himself.

sentences.zh: 賜雙眼孔雀翎，复予雲騎尉世職，賚貂冠、黑狐褂。

translations.literal: He was given a double-eyed peacock feather, his hereditary Cloud Cavalry Captaincy restored, and sable cap and black fox jacket.
translations.idiomatic: He received double-eyed peacock plume, restored Cloud Cavalry Captaincy, sable cap, and black fox jacket.

sentences.zh: 四十一年，金川平，圖形紫光閣。

translations.literal: In the forty-first year, when Jinchuan was pacified, his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor.
translations.idiomatic: In year 41 his portrait was placed in Purple Splendor after Jinchuan peace.

sentences.zh: 初，舒赫德為伊犁將軍，子舒寧在京杖斃二奴，得罪，上命發伊犁交舒赫德約束。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Shuhede was Ili general, his son Shuning in the capital beat two slaves to death with the stick, was found guilty, and the Emperor ordered him sent to Ili for Shuhede to discipline.
translations.idiomatic: When Shuhede was Ili general, his son Shuning killed two slaves in Beijing and was sent to Ili for his father to discipline.

sentences.zh: 及是，又以爭煤礦為山東民所訟，舒赫德縛舒寧送刑部，疏請罪。

translations.literal: By then he was also sued by Shandong commoners over a coal-mine dispute; Shuhede bound Shuning and sent him to the Ministry of Punishments, memorializing for punishment.
translations.idiomatic: He was also sued in Shandong over a coal mine; Shuhede sent Shuning to Punishments and asked for sentence.

sentences.zh: 下部議奪官，命寬之。

translations.literal: The ministry recommended stripping rank; mercy was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Stripping rank was recommended; the throne was lenient.

sentences.zh: 四十二年四月，卒，贈太保，諡文襄，祀賢良祠。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the forty-second year he died; he was posthumously made Grand Tutor, given the name Wenxiang, and enshrined in the Hall of Worthy Ministers.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of year 42 he died; posthumous Grand Tutor Wenxiang; enshrined among worthy ministers.

sentences.zh: 子舒常，始為侍衛。

translations.literal: His son Shuchang began as a bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: His son Shuchang started in the guards.

sentences.zh: 舒赫德議移置阿睦爾撒納妻子得罪，舒常亦奪官，發黑龍江披甲。

translations.literal: Because Shuhede was punished for planning to move Amursana wife and children, Shuchang also lost rank and was sent to Heilongjiang as a common soldier.
translations.idiomatic: When Shuhede fell for moving Amursana family, Shuchang lost rank and went to Heilongjiang as a soldier.

sentences.zh: 及舒赫德召還為副都統，授舒常三等侍衛。

translations.literal: When Shuhede was recalled and made Chinese deputy lieutenant-general, Shuchang was made third-class bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: When Shuhede returned as deputy lieutenant-general, Shuchang became third-class bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 舒赫德以佐成袞扎布無功再得罪，舒常復發黑龍江。

translations.literal: When Shuhede was again punished for aiding Chengun Zhabu without merit, Shuchang was again sent to Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: When Shuhede failed again with Chengun Zhabu, Shuchang went back to Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十三年二月，命釋還。

translations.literal: In the second month of Qianlong twenty-three he was ordered released and returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Qianlong 23 he was released and returned.

sentences.zh: 累遷至鑲藍旗護軍統領。

translations.literal: Through successive promotions he reached commandant of the Bordered Blue Banner guards.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to commandant of the Bordered Blue Banner guards.

sentences.zh: 三十七年，將軍溫福徵金川，授參贊大臣。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year, when General Wen Fu campaigned in Jinchuan, he was made campaign commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In year 37, during Wen Fu Jinchuan campaign, he became commissioner.

sentences.zh: 金川平，圖形紫光閣，與舒赫德父子並列前五十功臣。

translations.literal: When Jinchuan was pacified his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor, ranked with Shuhede father and son among the first fifty meritorious ministers.
translations.idiomatic: When Jinchuan fell his portrait joined Purple Splendor among the first fifty ministers with Shuhede and son.

sentences.zh: 舒赫德卒，令還京治喪，授工部侍郎。

translations.literal: When Shuhede died he was ordered back to the capital for mourning and made Works vice minister.
translations.idiomatic: At Shuhede death he returned to mourn and became Works vice minister.

sentences.zh: 出為貴州巡撫，遷湖廣、兩廣總督。

translations.literal: He went out as Guizhou governor and was transferred to governor-general of Huguang and Liangguang.
translations.idiomatic: He served as Guizhou governor, then Huguang and Liangguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 入為工部尚書。

translations.literal: He entered the capital as Works minister.
translations.idiomatic: He became Works minister in the capital.

sentences.zh: 復出署江西巡撫，復為湖廣總督。

translations.literal: He went out again as acting Jiangxi governor, then again governor-general of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: He acted as Jiangxi governor, then Huguang governor-general again.

sentences.zh: 荊州漢水決，奪官，授一等侍衛。

translations.literal: When the Han River burst at Jingzhou he lost rank and was made first-class bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: After the Jingzhou Han River breach he lost rank and became first-class bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 擢都察院左都御史，改鑲黃旗蒙古都統。

translations.literal: He was promoted to left censor-in-chief of the Censorate and transferred to Mongol lieutenant-general of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He became left censor-in-chief, then Bordered Yellow Mongol lieutenant-general.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶初，署刑、兵二部尚書。

translations.literal: Early in Jiaqing he acted as minister of Punishments and War.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Jiaqing he acted as Punishments and War minister.

sentences.zh: 卒，諡恪靖。

translations.literal: He died; posthumous name Kejing.
translations.idiomatic: He died and was given the posthumous name Kejing.

sentences.zh: 論曰：兆惠再就圍中受爵，得援師克竟其功；

translations.literal: The historians comment: Zhaohui twice received enfeoffment while surrounded and, with relief troops, completed his achievement;
translations.idiomatic: The historians say: Zhaohui was enfeoffed twice from within a siege and finished the war once relief came;

sentences.zh: 而為之援者，前則雅爾哈善，後則富德，顧坐法不克有終。

translations.literal: yet those who aided him—first Yarhashan, later Fude—both fell afoul of the law and could not see it through.
translations.idiomatic: yet Yarhashan before and Fude after both broke the law and could not finish.

sentences.zh: 訥親之誅也，高宗謂策楞、達爾黨阿皆愧奮，阿里袞獨內疑，遇事畏葸。

translations.literal: At Neqin execution Gaozong said Celeng and Dardanga were ashamed into zeal while Ali Gun alone inwardly doubted and shrank from action.
translations.idiomatic: At Neqin death Gaozong said Celeng and Dardanga fought ashamed while Ali Gun alone doubted and shrank.

sentences.zh: 然策楞、達爾黨阿先後僨事奪封，阿里袞以戰閥承世祚，豐升額繼之，慶延於後嗣。

translations.literal: Yet Celeng and Dardanga in turn failed and lost their titles; Ali Gun inherited martial honors and passed them down, Fengshengge succeeding, with blessings extending to later generations.
translations.idiomatic: Celeng and Dardanga lost their titles in failure; Ali Gun kept martial honors through Fengshengge to later heirs.

sentences.zh: 舒赫德初為御史有直聲，後出視軍，高宗屢言其懦，再被譴謫，終致台司。

translations.literal: Shuhede as censor first had a reputation for bluntness; later on campaign Gaozong often called him timid; twice punished, he still reached the highest provincial rank.
translations.idiomatic: Shuhede began blunt as censor, was often called timid on campaign, punished twice, yet reached the highest offices.

sentences.zh: 功名始終之際，蓋亦有天焉。

translations.literal: At the turn of fortune in fame there seems to be heaven hand as well.
translations.idiomatic: Fortune turning at the end seems heaven work too.

sentences.zh: 然其要必歸於忠謹，茲非彰彰可睹歟？

translations.literal: Yet the essence surely lies in loyalty and prudence—is that not plain to see?
translations.idiomatic: Yet loyalty and prudence are plainly the heart of it—is that not clear?
